波动问题Wave problems

练习这一节 →Practice this section →
知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

波动问题：方程与边界一起看Wave problems: read the equation and boundary conditions together

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

弦的运动既受方程控制，也受两端怎样固定控制。先列初始形状、初始速度和端点条件，再选适合的正弦或余弦。

A vibrating string is controlled by both its equation and its endpoints. List initial shape, initial velocity, and endpoint conditions before choosing sine or cosine modes.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

波动方程来自“质量×加速度＝受力”。弦横振动波速为 c=T/ρ，杆纵振动波速为 c=Y/ρ。固定端给位移条件，自由端给应力或斜率条件。

The wave equation comes from “mass × acceleration = force.” A string’s transverse wave speed is c=T/ρ; a rod’s longitudinal wave speed is c=Y/ρ. A fixed end prescribes displacement. A free end prescribes stress or slope.

utt=c2uxx,u=∑n(Ancosωnt+Bnsinωnt)Xn(x)
使用条件When it applies

线性小振幅、均匀材料；每个边界类型要选择对应的本征函数。

Small linear oscillations and a uniform material. Choose spatial eigenfunctions matching each boundary type.

展开分步证明 / 推导Open the step-by-step proof / derivation＋

先从力学得到方程：弦段质量为 ρdx，小斜率下张力的横向合力为 Tuxxdx，故 ρutt=Tuxx。

因此 c=T/ρ；杆纵振动用应力 Yux 做同样的平衡，得到 c=Y/ρ。

以两端固定为例，令 u=X(x)Θ(t)，代入并分离：X″/X=Θ″/(c2Θ)=−λ。

于是 X″+λX=0、Θ″+c2λΘ=0；固定端要求 X(0)=X(l)=0，选出 Xn=sin(nπx/l)、λn=(nπ/l)2。

时间解为 Ancosωnt+Bnsinωnt，ωn=cnπ/l。

由 u(x,0)=φ(x)，将等式乘 Xn 积分并用 ∫0lXn2dx=l/2，得 An=2l∫0lφXndx。

对时间求导再令 t=0，得到 Bn=2lωn∫0lvXndx。

这给出可操作的本征展开推导。

自由端改为零应力条件，空间基和频率也要重选；不能直接沿用固定端正弦。

级数是否可逐项求导取决于初值正则性；仅能量初值时按能量解理解。

Start with mechanics: a string segment has mass ρdx and transverse tension force Tuxxdx at small slope, so ρutt=Tuxx.

Hence c=T/ρ.

The same balance with rod stress Yux gives c=Y/ρ for longitudinal waves.

For two fixed ends, set u=X(x)Θ(t) and separate X″/X=Θ″/(c2Θ)=−λ.

Thus X″+λX=0 and Θ″+c2λΘ=0.

The conditions X(0)=X(l)=0 select Xn=sin(nπx/l) and λn=(nπ/l)2.

The time solution is Ancosωnt+Bnsinωnt, with ωn=cnπ/l.

Multiply u(x,0)=φ(x) by Xn, integrate, and use ∫0lXn2dx=l/2 to obtain An=2l∫0lφXndx.

Differentiate in time and evaluate at t=0 to get Bn=2lωn∫0lvXndx.

This is the working derivation of the modal expansion.

A free end imposes zero stress and changes the basis and frequencies; the fixed-end sine basis cannot simply be reused.

Termwise differentiation needs sufficiently regular initial data; energy data require an energy-solution interpretation.

做一道简单例题：按步骤看计算Worked example: follow each calculation＋
题目Problem

长度为 l 的弦两端固定，满足 utt=c2uxx。已知 u(x,0)=sin(πx/l)、ut(x,0)=0，求 u(x,t)。

A string of length l is fixed at both ends and satisfies utt=c2uxx. Given u(x,0)=sin(πx/l) and ut(x,0)=0, find u(x,t).

已知什么Given

这里 u(x,t) 是弦的位移，c 是波速；固定端表示 u(0,t)=u(l,t)=0。

Here u(x,t) is the string displacement and c is the wave speed; fixed ends mean u(0,t)=u(l,t)=0.

要求什么Find

写出满足方程、边界和两条初始条件的 u(x,t)。

Write the u(x,t) that satisfies the equation, the boundary conditions, and both initial conditions.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1选空间波形Choose the spatial mode
    为什么这样做Why this step

    两端固定时，sin(nπx/l) 在 x=0,l 都为零，所以它自动满足边界。

    For fixed ends, sin(nπx/l) vanishes at x=0,l, so it satisfies the boundary conditions automatically.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    初始位移正好是第一项 X1(x)=sin(πx/l)，因此只需保留 n=1。

    The initial displacement is exactly the first mode X1(x)=sin(πx/l), so only n=1 is needed.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2写时间因子Write the time factor
    为什么这样做Why this step

    对第 n 个波形，时间因子满足 Tn′′+ωn2Tn=0，其中 ωn=cnπ/l。

    For mode n, the time factor satisfies Tn′′+ωn2Tn=0, where ωn=cnπ/l.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    取 n=1 得 T1(t)=A1cos(cπt/l)+B1sin(cπt/l)。

    With n=1, T1(t)=A1cos(cπt/l)+B1sin(cπt/l).

  3. 第 3 步Step 3代初始位移Use the displacement
    为什么这样做Why this step

    令 t=0 可以直接确定余弦项的系数。

    Setting t=0 determines the coefficient of the cosine term directly.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    u(x,0)=A1sin(πx/l)=sin(πx/l)，所以 A1=1。

    u(x,0)=A1sin(πx/l)=sin(πx/l), so A1=1.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4代初始速度Use the velocity
    为什么这样做Why this step

    对时间求导后令 t=0，可以确定正弦项的系数。

    Differentiate in time and then set t=0 to determine the sine coefficient.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    ut(x,0)=B1(cπ/l)sin(πx/l)=0，所以 B1=0；最终 u(x,t)=sin(πx/l)cos(cπt/l)。

    ut(x,0)=B1(cπ/l)sin(πx/l)=0, so B1=0; hence u(x,t)=sin(πx/l)cos(cπt/l).

做完以后这样检查Check after solving

  • 边界：代入 x=0,l，都有 u=0。

    Boundary: at x=0,l, one gets u=0.

  • 初值：代入 t=0 得 u(x,0)=sin(πx/l)，再求导得 ut(x,0)=0。

    Initial data: at t=0, u(x,0)=sin(πx/l), and differentiation gives ut(x,0)=0.

  • 方程：utt=−(cπ/l)2u，uxx=−(π/l)2u，所以 utt=c2uxx。

    Equation: utt=−(cπ/l)2u and uxx=−(π/l)2u, so utt=c2uxx.

学完试一题：合上例题，自己做Try it yourself: close the worked example＋

先独立写第一步。卡住时只开一个提示，做完再核对答案。Write your first step independently. Open one hint if stuck; check the solution after attempting the problem.

一根左端固定、右端自由的均匀杆满足 utt=4uxx，0<x<π，t>0；边界为 u(0,t)=0、ux(π,t)=0。初始位移为 3sin(x/2)，初速度为 2sin(x/2)。求经典解，并说明为什么不能套两端固定的空间基。

A uniform rod has a fixed left end and a free right end. It satisfies utt=4uxx for 0<x<π, t>0, with u(0,t)=0 and ux(π,t)=0. Its initial displacement is 3sin(x/2) and its initial velocity is 2sin(x/2). Find the classical solution and explain why the spatial basis for two fixed ends does not apply.

提示 1：先选方法Hint 1: choose a method＋

先检查初值中的 sin(x/2) 是否同时满足两端条件。

First check whether sin(x/2) satisfies both endpoint conditions.

提示 2：写第一行Hint 2: write the first line＋

令 u=q(t)sin(x/2)，先算 uxx=−q(t)sin(x/2)/4。

Set u=q(t)sin(x/2) and first calculate uxx=−q(t)sin(x/2)/4.

提示 3：关键计算Hint 3: key calculation＋

时间方程为 q″+q=0，初值为 q(0)=3、q′(0)=2。

The time equation is q″+q=0, with q(0)=3 and q′(0)=2.

展开分步完整解答Open the full step-by-step solution＋

左端固定要求位移为零；右端自由要求轴向应力、因此位移斜率为零。

对 X=sin(x/2)，有 X(0)=0、X′(π)=cos(π/2)/2=0，所以它正好是本题的一个空间模态。

将 u=q(t)X(x) 代入方程。

因为 X″=−X/4，得到 q″X=−qX，故 q″+q=0。

于是 q=Acost+Bsint。

初始位移给 A=3；初速度给 B=2。

最终 u(x,t)=(3cost+2sint)sin(x/2)。

这里所有初值都是光滑函数且与边界相容，所写有限模态解是经典解。

两端固定时常用 sin(nx)；它在右端的导数为 ncos(nπ)，并不为零。

本题需要满足自由端条件的半整数波数，不能只凭“是振动题”就照搬整数正弦。

The fixed left end requires zero displacement.

The free right end requires zero axial stress and hence zero displacement slope.

For X=sin(x/2), we have X(0)=0 and X′(π)=cos(π/2)/2=0, so this is a spatial mode of this problem.

Substitute u=q(t)X(x) into the equation.

Since X″=−X/4, we obtain q″X=−qX and hence q″+q=0.

Thus q=Acost+Bsint.

The initial displacement gives A=3, and the initial velocity gives B=2.

Therefore u(x,t)=(3cost+2sint)sin(x/2).

All initial data are smooth and compatible with the boundaries, so this finite-mode expression is a classical solution.

For two fixed ends one commonly uses sin(nx), but its derivative at the right end is ncos(nπ), which is nonzero.

This problem requires half-integer wave numbers to satisfy the free-end condition; identifying a vibration problem alone does not determine the basis.

怎样检查，哪里容易错Check your result and common mistakes＋

代回检查 utt=4uxx，并分别检查位移、速度和两端条件。典型错误是把初速度系数直接当成正弦时间项系数；一般还要除以模态频率，本题频率恰好为一。

Substitute back to check utt=4uxx, then check the displacement, velocity, and both boundaries separately. A common error is to use the initial-velocity coefficient directly as the sine-in-time coefficient: in general it must be divided by the modal frequency, which happens to be one here.

记忆线索Memory cue

位移决定余弦时间项，速度决定正弦时间项；边界先于系数。

Displacement supplies cosine-in-time terms; velocity supplies sine-in-time terms. Choose the boundary-compatible modes before finding coefficients.

知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

达朗贝尔公式与特征线D’Alembert’s formula and characteristics

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

无限长弦的初始形状会拆成向左、向右传播的两部分。看自变量里的加减号判断方向，再用初值确定它们的大小。

An infinite string’s initial shape splits into left- and right-traveling pieces. Read the signs in their arguments to determine direction, then use the initial data to determine amplitudes.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

无限弦的位移由两个反向传播的波叠加。初速度不是直接乘 t，而是在影响区间上积分。固定端半轴问题可以先奇延拓。

An infinite string’s displacement is the sum of waves traveling in opposite directions. Initial velocity contributes an integral over the region of influence, rather than simply velocity multiplied by t. A fixed-end half-line can be handled by odd extension.

u(x,t)=φ(x−ct)+φ(x+ct)2+12c∫x−ctx+ctv(s)ds
使用条件When it applies

utt=c2uxx，全轴、无外力；初值为位移 φ 和速度 v。经典解要求足够光滑。半轴固定端用奇延拓，绝热/自由端用偶延拓。

For utt=c2uxx on the full line, without forcing, φ is the initial displacement and v the initial velocity. A classical solution needs sufficient smoothness. On a half-line, use odd extension for a fixed end and even extension for an insulated/free end.

展开分步证明 / 推导Open the step-by-step proof / derivation＋

引入特征坐标 ξ=x−ct、η=x+ct。

链式法则给 ∂x=∂ξ+∂η、∂t=−c∂ξ+c∂η，所以 utt−c2uxx=−4c2uξη，无源方程变为 uξη=0。

先对一个变量积分，再对另一个变量积分，得到 u=F(ξ)+G(η)。

在 t=0，位移给 F(x)+G(x)=φ(x)，速度给 c[G′(x)−F′(x)]=v(x)；再对位移等式求导，得到 F′+G′=φ′。

解这两个关于导数的方程：F′=(φ′−v/c)/2、G′=(φ′+v/c)/2。

分别积分并把 x−ct、x+ct 代入相加，积分常数由初位移合并，得到 u=12[φ(x−ct)+φ(x+ct)]+12c∫x−ctx+ctv(s)ds。

积分端点求导给初速度项 12[v(x+ct)+v(x−ct)]，在 t=0 恰为 v(x)；位移平均项的时间导数在零时相消。

半轴固定端用奇延拓使边界值相消，自由端用偶延拓使空间导数相消；非零端点运动还需另加边界响应。

Introduce characteristic coordinates ξ=x−ct and η=x+ct.

The chain rule gives ∂x=∂ξ+∂η and ∂t=−c∂ξ+c∂η, so utt−c2uxx=−4c2uξη.

The source-free equation becomes uξη=0.

Integrating once in each variable gives u=F(ξ)+G(η).

At t=0, displacement gives F(x)+G(x)=φ(x) and velocity gives c[G′(x)−F′(x)]=v(x).

Differentiating the displacement relation gives F′+G′=φ′.

Solve the two derivative equations: F′=(φ′−v/c)/2 and G′=(φ′+v/c)/2.

Integrate and evaluate at x−ct and x+ct; the constants combine according to the initial displacement, giving u=12[φ(x−ct)+φ(x+ct)]+12c∫x−ctx+ctv(s)ds.

Differentiating the integral endpoints gives 12[v(x+ct)+v(x−ct)], which is v(x) at t=0; the time derivatives of the displacement average cancel there.

On a half-line, odd extension cancels a fixed-end value, while even extension cancels a free-end derivative.

Nonzero endpoint motion needs an additional boundary response.

做一道简单例题：按步骤看计算Worked example: follow each calculation＋
题目Problem

全轴波动方程 utt=c2uxx 的初位移为 φ(x)=0，初速度为常数 v(x)=V。求 u(x,t)。

For the full-line wave equation utt=c2uxx, the initial displacement is φ(x)=0 and the initial velocity is the constant v(x)=V. Find u(x,t).

已知什么Given

这里 c>0 是波速，V 是常数；全轴表示 −∞<x<∞，没有端点边界。

Here c>0 is the wave speed and V is constant; the full line means −∞<x<∞, with no endpoint boundary.

要求什么Find

用达朗贝尔公式算出 u(x,t)，并说明为什么结果与 x 无关。

Use d'Alembert's formula to compute u(x,t) and explain why the result is independent of x.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1写出公式Write the formula
    为什么这样做Why this step

    全轴、无外力的初值问题可以直接使用达朗贝尔公式。

    The full-line initial-value problem with no forcing can be solved directly by d'Alembert's formula.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    u(x,t)=φ(x−ct)+φ(x+ct)2+12c∫x−ctx+ctv(s)ds。

  2. 第 2 步Step 2处理位移项Handle displacement
    为什么这样做Why this step

    已知初位移处处为零，所以公式的前半部分消失。

    The initial displacement is zero everywhere, so the first part of the formula vanishes.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    φ(x−ct)=φ(x+ct)=0，因此 φ(x−ct)+φ(x+ct)2=0。

    φ(x−ct)=φ(x+ct)=0, hence φ(x−ct)+φ(x+ct)2=0.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3计算速度积分Evaluate the velocity integral
    为什么这样做Why this step

    初速度是常数，积分就是“常数乘区间长度”。

    Because the initial velocity is constant, the integral is the constant times the interval length.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    ∫x−ctx+ctVds=V[(x+ct)−(x−ct)]=2cVt。

  4. 第 4 步Step 4得到结果Obtain the answer
    为什么这样做Why this step

    把积分除以公式中的 2c，所有与 x 有关的端点项正好相消。

    Divide the integral by the 2c in the formula; the endpoint terms involving x cancel.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    u(x,t)=2cVt2c=Vt；每一点具有相同初速度，所以位移不随 x 改变。

    u(x,t)=2cVt2c=Vt; every point has the same initial velocity, so the displacement does not depend on x.

做完以后这样检查Check after solving

  • 初值：u(x,0)=0，并且 ut(x,0)=V。

    Initial data: u(x,0)=0 and ut(x,0)=V.

  • 方程：utt=0 且 uxx=0，所以 utt=c2uxx。

    Equation: utt=0 and uxx=0, so utt=c2uxx.

  • 量纲：Vt 是“速度乘时间”，量纲确实是位移。

    Units: Vt is velocity times time, so it has the units of displacement.

学完试一题：合上例题，自己做Try it yourself: close the worked example＋

先独立写第一步。卡住时只开一个提示，做完再核对答案。Write your first step independently. Open one hint if stuck; check the solution after attempting the problem.

全轴波动方程为 utt=4uxx，x∈R、t≥0，初值为 u(x,0)=x2、ut(x,0)=2x。用达朗贝尔公式求解。这里求光滑经典解，不要求总能量有限。

On the whole line, solve utt=4uxx for x∈R, t≥0, with u(x,0)=x2 and ut(x,0)=2x, using d'Alembert's formula. Seek a smooth classical solution; finite total energy is not required.

提示 1：先选方法Hint 1: choose a method＋

先从方程读出波速 c=2；两个取值点是 x−2t 和 x+2t。

Read the wave speed c=2 from the equation; the two sampling points are x−2t and x+2t.

提示 2：写第一行Hint 2: write the first line＋

写成 u=(x−2t)2+(x+2t)22+14∫x−2tx+2t2sds。

Write u=(x−2t)2+(x+2t)22+14∫x−2tx+2t2sds.

提示 3：关键计算Hint 3: key calculation＋

两个平方的平均为 x2+4t2；积分项为 2xt。

The average of the two squares is x2+4t2; the integral contribution is 2xt.

展开分步完整解答Open the full step-by-step solution＋
  1. 第 1 步Step 1

    全轴且无外力，直接使用达朗贝尔公式 u=12[φ(x−ct)+φ(x+ct)]+12c∫x−ctx+ctv(s)ds。

    The domain is the whole line and there is no forcing, so use d'Alembert's formula u=12[φ(x−ct)+φ(x+ct)]+12c∫x−ctx+ctv(s)ds.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2

    本题 c=2，所以初速度积分前的系数为 1/4。

    Here c=2, so the coefficient of the velocity integral is 1/4.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3

    位移项为 [(x−2t)2+(x+2t)2]/2=x2+4t2，因为两个交叉项相消。

    The displacement contribution is [(x−2t)2+(x+2t)2]/2=x2+4t2 because the cross terms cancel.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4

    速度项为 [(x+2t)2−(x−2t)2]/4=2xt。

    The velocity contribution is [(x+2t)2−(x−2t)2]/4=2xt.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5

    相加得到 u(x,t)=x2+2xt+4t2。

    Adding the contributions gives u(x,t)=x2+2xt+4t2.

  6. 第 6 步Step 6

    它在全轴上光滑。

    It is smooth on the whole line.

  7. 第 7 步Step 7

    初值虽不衰减，达朗贝尔公式在每个有限的特征区间内仍可正常积分，不需要把它误当作有限能量问题。

    Although the initial data do not decay, the formula only integrates over a finite characteristic interval at each point, so the calculation is valid without a finite-energy assumption.

怎样检查，哪里容易错Check your result and common mistakes＋

计算 utt=8、uxx=2，并检查 u(x,0)=x2、ut(x,0)=2x。典型错误是漏掉初速度积分，或把它的系数写成一半。

Calculate utt=8 and uxx=2, and check u(x,0)=x2 and ut(x,0)=2x. Common errors are omitting the velocity integral or incorrectly using one half as its coefficient.

位移取两端平均；速度取中间面积除 2c。

Average the displacement at the two endpoints; integrate the velocity between them and divide by 2c.

知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

非齐次方程的模态方程与共振Modal equations for forcing and resonance

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

外力会不断向系统输入运动。先把空间形状拆成模态，每个模态只剩一条时间方程；外力频率相同时要单独处理共振。

A force drives the motion over time. Expand its spatial shape into modes, solve a time equation for each, and treat resonance separately when frequencies coincide.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

空间边界齐次后，把外力和初值投影到相同本征函数上。每个模态都是一个受迫振子，共振时不能使用零分母的非共振公式。

Once spatial boundary conditions are homogeneous, project the forcing and initial data onto the same eigenfunctions. Each mode is a forced oscillator. At resonance, the nonresonant formula has a zero denominator and must be replaced.

qn′′+ωn2qn=Fn(t),qn=Ancosωnt+Bnsinωnt+1ωn∫0tFn(s)sin[ωn(t−s)]ds
使用条件When it applies

采用正交空间本征系，ωn>0；Bn=qn′(0)/ωn。零模态须单独解 q0′′=F0。阻尼项存在时要相应修改时间方程。

Use an orthogonal spatial eigenbasis with ωn>0 and Bn=qn′(0)/ωn. A zero mode must separately solve q0′′=F0. Damping modifies the time equation.

展开分步证明 / 推导Open the step-by-step proof / derivation＋

先将边界齐次化，再选满足 Xn′′+λnXn=0 的正交基。

把 u=∑qnXn 代入 utt−c2uxx=f(x,t)，乘 Xn 积分并除以 Nn=∫Xn2dx，得 qn′′+ωn2qn=Fn(t)，其中 ωn2=c2λn、Fn=∫fXndx/Nn。

对一个 ωn>0 的模态，定义零初值响应 rn(t)=1ωn∫0tFn(s)sin[ωn(t−s)]ds。

上限处正弦为零，所以 rn′=∫0tFn(s)cos[ωn(t−s)]ds。

再求导，上限产生 Fn(t)，积分部分产生 −ωn2rn，故 rn′′+ωn2rn=Fn。

两个积分在零时为空，所以 rn(0)=rn′(0)=0；再加 Ancosωnt+Bnsinωnt 来满足一般初值。

这个卷积表达式在共振时仍有意义。

若改用待定系数公式出现 ωn2−Ω2 分母，须单列 Ω=ωn；零模态则直接积分 q0′′=F0，不能除以零频率。

First make the boundaries homogeneous and choose an orthogonal basis with Xn′′+λnXn=0.

Substitute u=∑qnXn into utt−c2uxx=f(x,t), multiply by Xn, integrate, and divide by Nn=∫Xn2dx to get qn′′+ωn2qn=Fn(t), where ωn2=c2λn and Fn=∫fXndx/Nn.

For a mode with ωn>0, define the zero-data response rn(t)=1ωn∫0tFn(s)sin[ωn(t−s)]ds.

The sine is zero at the upper limit, so rn′=∫0tFn(s)cos[ωn(t−s)]ds.

Differentiating again produces upper-limit term Fn(t) and integral term −ωn2rn, proving rn′′+ωn2rn=Fn.

Both integrals are empty at zero, so rn(0)=rn′(0)=0.

Add Ancosωnt+Bnsinωnt for general initial data.

The convolution remains meaningful at resonance.

If a trial-solution formula introduces denominator ωn2−Ω2, treat Ω=ωn separately.

For a zero mode, integrate q0′′=F0 directly instead of dividing by zero frequency.

做一道简单例题：按步骤看计算Worked example: follow each calculation＋
题目Problem

设 ω>0，求零初值问题 q″+ω2q=Fcosωt、q(0)=q′(0)=0 的解。

Let ω>0. Solve the zero-initial-data problem q″+ω2q=Fcosωt with q(0)=q′(0)=0.

已知什么Given

这里 q(t) 是一个模态的振幅，ω 是固有角频率，F 是常数外力振幅。

Here q(t) is one modal amplitude, ω is its natural angular frequency, and F is the constant forcing amplitude.

要求什么Find

算出共振响应 q(t)，并看清线性增长因子从哪里出现。

Compute the resonant response q(t) and see exactly where the linearly growing factor comes from.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1识别共振Recognize resonance
    为什么这样做Why this step

    外力 Fcosωt 的频率与方程的固有频率 ω 相同，普通的余弦试解会与齐次解重复。

    The forcing Fcosωt has the same frequency as the natural frequency ω, so an ordinary cosine trial duplicates a homogeneous solution.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    把试解多乘一个 t，令 qp(t)=Ctsinωt。

    Multiply the trial by t and set qp(t)=Ctsinωt.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2求一阶导数Differentiate once
    为什么这样做Why this step

    方程含 q″，所以要按乘积求导法则连续求导两次。

    The equation contains q″, so apply the product rule twice in succession.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    qp′(t)=Csinωt+Cωtcosωt。

  3. 第 3 步Step 3求二阶导数Differentiate twice
    为什么这样做Why this step

    再次求导时，两处都会产生 Cωcosωt。

    On differentiating again, two terms each produce Cωcosωt.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    qp′′(t)=2Cωcosωt−Cω2tsinωt。

  4. 第 4 步Step 4代回定系数Substitute and solve
    为什么这样做Why this step

    代回后，含 tsinωt 的两项会相消，只剩与外力同形的余弦项。

    After substitution, the two tsinωt terms cancel, leaving a cosine term matching the forcing.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    qp′′+ω2qp=2Cωcosωt=Fcosωt，所以 C=F/(2ω)。

    qp′′+ω2qp=2Cωcosωt=Fcosωt, so C=F/(2ω).

  5. 第 5 步Step 5检查零初值Check the initial data
    为什么这样做Why this step

    若特解已经满足零初值，就不需要再添加齐次项。

    If the particular solution already has zero initial data, no homogeneous correction is needed.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    qp(0)=0 且 qp′(0)=0，因此 q(t)=F2ωtsinωt。

    qp(0)=0 and qp′(0)=0, hence q(t)=F2ωtsinωt.

做完以后这样检查Check after solving

  • 代回：由上面的导数可得 q″+ω2q=Fcosωt。

    Substitution: the derivatives above give q″+ω2q=Fcosωt.

  • 初值：q(0)=0，并且 q′(0)=0。

    Initial data: q(0)=0 and q′(0)=0.

  • 形状：振荡仍为 sinωt，但包络 Ft/(2ω) 随时间线性增大。

    Shape: the oscillation is still sinωt, while its envelope Ft/(2ω) grows linearly in time.

学完试一题：合上例题，自己做Try it yourself: close the worked example＋

先独立写第一步。卡住时只开一个提示，做完再核对答案。Write your first step independently. Open one hint if stuck; check the solution after attempting the problem.

求 utt−uxx=6t+4cos(2x)cos(2t) 在 0<x<π、t>0 的解，边界为 ux(0,t)=ux(π,t)=0，初始位移和初速度均为零。区分常数空间模态与第二余弦模态；所有数据均光滑。

Solve utt−uxx=6t+4cos(2x)cos(2t) for 0<x<π, t>0, with ux(0,t)=ux(π,t)=0 and zero initial displacement and velocity. Distinguish the constant spatial mode from the second cosine mode. All data are smooth.

提示 1：先选方法Hint 1: choose a method＋

零导数边界允许常数模态，因此设 u=q0(t)+q2(t)cos(2x)。

The zero-derivative boundaries allow a constant mode, so set u=q0(t)+q2(t)cos(2x).

提示 2：写第一行Hint 2: write the first line＋

分别得到 q0′′=6t 和 q2′′+4q2=4cos(2t)，两组初值均为零。

The equations are q0′′=6t and q2′′+4q2=4cos(2t), both with zero initial data.

提示 3：关键计算Hint 3: key calculation＋

常数模态积分两次；第二模态是共振，可试 q2=Atsin(2t)。

Integrate the constant-mode equation twice. The second mode is resonant; try q2=Atsin(2t).

展开分步完整解答Open the full step-by-step solution＋

边界为零法向导数，常数和 cos(2x) 都满足边界。

因此将解写成 u=q0+q2cos(2x)，将两个空间系数分别比较，得到 q0′′=6t、q2′′+4q2=4cos(2t)。

常数模态的频率为零，不能代入含有除以频率的振动公式。

直接积分得 q0′=3t2+C、q0=t3+Ct+D；零初值给 C=D=0，故 q0=t3。

第二模态的自由频率和外力频率都为二。

试 q2=Atsin(2t)，求导后 q2′′+4q2=4Acos(2t)，因此 A=1。

此表达式的位移和速度初值也都是零。

因此 u(x,t)=t3+tsin(2t)cos(2x)。

常数部分来自零频率模态；振幅随时间线性增长的余弦空间部分来自共振，两种增长机制应分开理解。

The boundary derivatives vanish, and both a constant and cos(2x) satisfy these conditions.

Write u=q0+q2cos(2x) and compare the spatial coefficients separately to obtain q0′′=6t and q2′′+4q2=4cos(2t).

The constant mode has zero frequency, so formulas that divide by the frequency cannot be used.

Direct integration gives q0′=3t2+C and q0=t3+Ct+D.

Zero initial data give C=D=0, so q0=t3.

Both the natural frequency of the second mode and the forcing frequency equal two.

Try q2=Atsin(2t); differentiation gives q2′′+4q2=4Acos(2t), hence A=1.

This expression also has zero initial displacement and velocity.

Therefore u(x,t)=t3+tsin(2t)cos(2x).

The spatially constant contribution comes from the zero-frequency mode, whereas the cosine contribution has a linearly growing envelope because of resonance.

These are distinct mechanisms.

怎样检查，哪里容易错Check your result and common mistakes＋

直接计算 utt−uxx=6t+4cos(2x)cos(2t)，再检查两端导数和零初值。典型错误是漏掉常数模态，或把共振响应写成有界的余弦。

Calculate directly that utt−uxx=6t+4cos(2x)cos(2t), then check both endpoint derivatives and the zero initial data. Common errors are discarding the constant mode or writing a bounded cosine response at resonance.

空间先正交投影，时间再解振子；遇零分母先检查共振。

Project in space first, then solve the oscillator in time. A zero denominator means check resonance.

输运问题Transport problems

练习这一节 →Practice this section →
知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

输运问题：方程与边界一起看Transport problems: read the equation and boundary conditions together

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

热会让不均匀的温度逐渐变平。先看端点是固定温度还是绝热，这决定展开的基底；再给每一项乘衰减因子。

Diffusion smooths uneven temperatures. Fixed-temperature and insulated endpoints select different bases. Attach the appropriate decay factor to each mode.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

热量守恒与傅里叶导热定律给热方程。无源热方程的各非零空间模态随时间指数衰减；保温边界保留零模态，固定零温边界没有零模态。

Heat conservation and Fourier’s law give the heat equation. Every nonzero spatial mode of the source-free heat equation decays exponentially. Insulated boundaries retain a zero mode; fixed zero-temperature boundaries do not.

ut=κΔu+s,κ=kρc
使用条件When it applies

均匀介质，k 为导热系数、ρc 为单位体积热容；外源 s 已除以热容。

The medium is uniform. k is thermal conductivity and ρc is heat capacity per unit volume. The source s has already been divided by that heat capacity.

展开分步证明 / 推导Open the step-by-step proof / derivation＋

令 q 为单位体积产热率。

杆段的储热率是 ρcSutdx；傅里叶热流向右为 −kSux，左端输入减右端输出给净导热输入 kS[ux(x+dx)−ux(x)]。

热量守恒给 ρcSutdx=kSuxxdx+qSdx。

除以 ρcSdx 得 ut=κuxx+s，其中 κ=k/(ρc)、s=q/(ρc)；高维时 uxx 换成 Δu。

无源且齐次边界时，选空间基满足 −ΔXn=λnXn，令一项为 un=an(t)Xn。

代入得到 an′=−κλnan，故 an(t)=an(0)e−κλnt；热方程时间一阶，只需初始温度。

固定零温边界在常见有界域中没有常数零模态，温度可衰减到零。

全绝热边界允许 X0=1、λ0=0，其平均温度不衰减；这与没有边界热量流出相一致。

Let q be heat generation per unit volume per unit time.

A segment stores heat at rate ρcSutdx.

Fourier flux to the right is −kSux, so left input minus right output gives kS[ux(x+dx)−ux(x)].

Conservation gives ρcSutdx=kSuxxdx+qSdx.

Divide by ρcSdx to obtain ut=κuxx+s, with κ=k/(ρc) and s=q/(ρc).

In higher dimensions replace uxx by Δu.

With no source and homogeneous boundaries, choose −ΔXn=λnXn and set un=an(t)Xn.

Substitution gives an′=−κλnan, hence an(t)=an(0)e−κλnt.

The equation is first order in time and requires only initial temperature.

Fixed zero-temperature boundaries on usual bounded domains exclude a constant zero mode, allowing decay to zero.

Complete insulation permits X0=1 and λ0=0, so the mean temperature remains unchanged, consistent with no boundary heat loss.

做一道简单例题：按步骤看计算Worked example: follow each calculation＋
题目Problem

长度为 l 的细杆满足 ut=κuxx，两端保持零温。若 u(x,0)=sin(2πx/l)，求 u(x,t)。

A thin rod of length l satisfies ut=κuxx, and both ends are held at zero temperature. If u(x,0)=sin(2πx/l), find u(x,t).

已知什么Given

这里 u(x,t) 是温度，κ>0 是热扩散率；零温边界为 u(0,t)=u(l,t)=0。

Here u(x,t) is temperature and κ>0 is thermal diffusivity; the zero-temperature boundaries are u(0,t)=u(l,t)=0.

要求什么Find

求温度 u(x,t)，并看出这个空间波形的衰减速度。

Find the temperature u(x,t) and identify the decay rate of this spatial mode.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1识别空间模态Identify the spatial mode
    为什么这样做Why this step

    零温两端对应正弦基 sin(nπx/l)，每一项都自动满足端点条件。

    Zero-temperature ends correspond to the sine basis sin(nπx/l), whose terms satisfy both endpoint conditions automatically.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    sin(2πx/l) 就是 n=2 的模态，所以设 u(x,t)=a2(t)sin(2πx/l)。

    sin(2πx/l) is the mode n=2, so set u(x,t)=a2(t)sin(2πx/l).

  2. 第 2 步Step 2计算空间二阶导数Differentiate in space
    为什么这样做Why this step

    热方程右边含 uxx，二阶导数会给出模态的衰减系数。

    The right side of the heat equation contains uxx, and this second derivative supplies the modal decay coefficient.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    uxx=−(2π/l)2a2(t)sin(2πx/l)。

  3. 第 3 步Step 3得到时间方程Obtain the time equation
    为什么这样做Why this step

    把 ut 和 uxx 代入后，可约去共同的正弦因子。

    After substituting ut and uxx, cancel their common sine factor.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    a2′(t)=−κ(2π/l)2a2(t)=−4κπ2a2(t)/l2。

  4. 第 4 步Step 4解衰减方程Solve the decay equation
    为什么这样做Why this step

    方程 a2′=−αa2 的解是指数衰减，初温给出 a2(0)=1。

    The equation a2′=−αa2 has an exponential decay solution, and the initial temperature gives a2(0)=1.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    a2(t)=e−4κπ2t/l2，因此 u(x,t)=e−4κπ2t/l2sin(2πx/l)。

    a2(t)=e−4κπ2t/l2, hence u(x,t)=e−4κπ2t/l2sin(2πx/l).

做完以后这样检查Check after solving

  • 边界：代入 x=0,l，都有 u=0。

    Boundary: at x=0,l, one gets u=0.

  • 初值：代入 t=0，指数为 1，故 u(x,0)=sin(2πx/l)。

    Initial value: at t=0, the exponential is 1, so u(x,0)=sin(2πx/l).

  • 方程：ut=−4κπ2u/l2 且 uxx=−4π2u/l2，所以 ut=κuxx。

    Equation: ut=−4κπ2u/l2 and uxx=−4π2u/l2, so ut=κuxx.

学完试一题：合上例题，自己做Try it yourself: close the worked example＋

先独立写第一步。卡住时只开一个提示，做完再核对答案。Write your first step independently. Open one hint if stuck; check the solution after attempting the problem.

一根绝热杆满足 ut=12uxx，0<x<π、t>0，两端条件为 ux(0,t)=ux(π,t)=0，初温为 u(x,0)=4+3cos(2x)。求温度及长期极限，并解释为什么不会全部降到零。

An insulated rod satisfies ut=12uxx for 0<x<π, t>0, with ux(0,t)=ux(π,t)=0 and initial temperature u(x,0)=4+3cos(2x). Find the temperature and its long-time limit, and explain why it does not all decay to zero.

提示 1：先选方法Hint 1: choose a method＋

初温已经是常数模态与一个余弦模态的和。设 u=a(t)+b(t)cos(2x)。

The initial temperature is already the sum of a constant mode and one cosine mode. Set u=a(t)+b(t)cos(2x).

提示 2：写第一行Hint 2: write the first line＋

由空间二阶导数得到 a′=0、b′=−2b。

The second spatial derivative gives a′=0 and b′=−2b.

提示 3：关键计算Hint 3: key calculation＋

用 a(0)=4、b(0)=3，常数部分保留，余弦部分乘上 e−2t。

Use a(0)=4 and b(0)=3: the constant part remains and the cosine part acquires a factor e−2t.

展开分步完整解答Open the full step-by-step solution＋

两端绝热对应零温度导数；常数和 cos(2x) 都满足此边界。

代入 u=a+bcos(2x)，有 uxx=−4bcos(2x)，故 a′=0、b′=−2b。

积分得 a=4、b=3e−2t，因此 u(x,t)=4+3e−2tcos(2x)。

初值与边界相容，有限模态表达式是光滑经典解。

长期极限为 u→4。

绝热意味着热量不经端点流失；初始平均温度为 1π∫0π[4+3cos(2x)]dx=4。

扩散消除的是温度起伏，保留下来的常数就是平均温度。

Insulated ends require zero temperature derivative; both a constant and cos(2x) satisfy these boundaries.

Substitute u=a+bcos(2x) to obtain uxx=−4bcos(2x), so a′=0 and b′=−2b.

Integration gives a=4 and b=3e−2t, hence u(x,t)=4+3e−2tcos(2x).

The initial data are compatible with the boundaries, and this finite-mode expression is a smooth classical solution.

The long-time limit is u→4.

Insulation prevents heat loss through the ends.

The initial mean temperature is 1π∫0π[4+3cos(2x)]dx=4.

Diffusion removes temperature variations while preserving their constant mean.

怎样检查，哪里容易错Check your result and common mistakes＋

检查 ut=−6e−2tcos(2x)=uxx/2，以及 ∫0πudx=4π 始终不变。典型错误是套用两端零温的正弦展开，错误删除零模态。

Check ut=−6e−2tcos(2x)=uxx/2 and the conserved quantity ∫0πudx=4π. A common error is to use the sine expansion for zero-temperature ends and incorrectly remove the zero mode.

合上答案重做一次，仍卡住可用下方按钮加入记忆回顾。Close the solution and try again. Use the button below to add this concept to recall if you still need help.

记忆线索Memory cue

热方程时间一阶，初值只要一个；频率越高衰减越快。

The heat equation is first order in time and needs one initial condition. Higher spatial frequencies decay faster.

知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

热核、镜像延拓与扩散尺度The heat kernel, image extension, and diffusion scale

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

热核告诉你一小团热经过一段时间会扩散成什么样。把各处初温加权叠加，就得到以后温度；有边界时要用合适的镜像。

The heat kernel describes how a concentrated pulse spreads. Weight and add these responses using the initial temperature, with suitable images when a boundary is present.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

无限域热核是随时间变宽的 Gaussian。半轴零温用反号镜像，半轴绝热用同号镜像。扩散影响尺度随 t 增长。

The infinite-domain heat kernel is a Gaussian that broadens with time. For a zero-temperature half-line boundary, subtract the reflected image. For an insulated boundary, add it. The diffusion scale grows as t.

K(x,t)=e−x2/(4κt)4πκt,u(x,t)=∫RK(x−ξ,t)φ(ξ)dξ
使用条件When it applies

ut=κuxx、κ>0、t>0、无源全轴。初值按连续点极限或适当 Lᵖ 意义恢复。半轴边界必须先区分 Dirichlet 和 Neumann。

For ut=κuxx, κ>0 and t>0, on the source-free full line. Initial data are recovered at continuity points or in an appropriate Lᵖ sense. On the half-line, distinguish Dirichlet from Neumann boundaries first.

展开分步证明 / 推导Open the step-by-step proof / derivation＋

采用 u^(k)=∫Ru(x)e−ikxdx，逆变换带 1/(2π)。

充分衰减时分部积分给 uxx^=−k2u^，所以热方程化为 u^t=−κk2u^，得 u^=e−κk2tφ^。

高斯逆变换为 K(x,t)=e−x2/(4κt)/4πκt。

由变换乘积对应卷积，得到 u(x,t)=∫RK(x−ξ,t)φ(ξ)dξ；这里是全轴无源解，有限区间不能直接忽略边界套用。

令 z=x/4κt，有 ∫Kdx=1π∫e−z2dz=1。

当 t↓0，核的质量集中于零而总量不变，因此在连续点恢复初值；脉冲初值则按分布意义恢复。

半轴上分开正负轴积分：奇延拓得到 ∫0∞[K(x−ξ)−K(x+ξ)]φ(ξ)dξ，偶延拓改为加号。

因为 K 为偶函数，前者在零点的值抵消；因为 Kx 为奇函数，后者在零点的空间一阶导数抵消。

Use u^(k)=∫Ru(x)e−ikxdx with inverse factor 1/(2π).

With adequate decay, integration by parts gives uxx^=−k2u^.

Thus u^t=−κk2u^, giving u^=e−κk2tφ^.

The Gaussian inverse transform is K(x,t)=e−x2/(4κt)/4πκt.

Transform products become convolution, giving u(x,t)=∫RK(x−ξ,t)φ(ξ)dξ.

This is a whole-line source-free solution, not a finite-interval formula that ignores boundaries.

Set z=x/4κt to obtain ∫Kdx=1π∫e−z2dz=1.

As t↓0, the mass concentrates at zero while its total remains fixed, recovering continuous initial data pointwise and impulse data distributionally.

On a half-line, split the positive and negative integrals.

Odd extension gives ∫0∞[K(x−ξ)−K(x+ξ)]φ(ξ)dξ, while even extension uses a plus sign.

The evenness of K cancels the value of the minus-sign expression at zero; the oddness of Kx cancels the first spatial derivative of the plus-sign expression there.

做一道简单例题：按步骤看计算Worked example: follow each calculation＋
题目Problem

全轴热方程 ut=κuxx 的初温是单位点脉冲 u(x,0)=δ(x)。求 u(x,t)，并判断总热量是否改变。

For the full-line heat equation ut=κuxx, the initial temperature is the unit point impulse u(x,0)=δ(x). Find u(x,t) and decide whether the total heat changes.

已知什么Given

这里 κ>0 是热扩散率，δ(x) 表示总量为 1、集中在 x=0 的点脉冲。

Here κ>0 is thermal diffusivity, and δ(x) denotes a point impulse of total amount 1 concentrated at x=0.

要求什么Find

写出热核 u(x,t)，算出 ∫−∞∞u(x,t)dx，并读出峰值和扩散尺度。

Write the heat kernel u(x,t), compute ∫−∞∞u(x,t)dx, and read off its peak and diffusion scale.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1写出热核Write the heat kernel
    为什么这样做Why this step

    点脉冲与热核卷积时只会抽取热核本身。

    Convolving a point impulse with the heat kernel returns the heat kernel itself.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    u(x,t)=K(x,t)=14πκte−x2/(4κt)，其中 t>0。

    u(x,t)=K(x,t)=14πκte−x2/(4κt), where t>0.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2计算总量Compute the total amount
    为什么这样做Why this step

    总热量是对空间积分；用变量替换可把它化成标准高斯积分。

    Total heat is the spatial integral; a substitution turns it into the standard Gaussian integral.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    令 z=x/4κt，则 ∫−∞∞K(x,t)dx=1π∫−∞∞e−z2dz=1。

    Let z=x/4κt; then ∫−∞∞K(x,t)dx=1π∫−∞∞e−z2dz=1.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3读取峰值Read off the peak
    为什么这样做Why this step

    指数在 x=0 时最大，所以温度峰值位于原脉冲位置。

    The exponential is largest at x=0, so the temperature peak remains at the original impulse location.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    K(0,t)=1/4πκt，因此峰值按 t−1/2 降低。

    K(0,t)=1/4πκt, so the peak falls like t−1/2.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4读取扩散宽度Read off the width
    为什么这样做Why this step

    指数不太小时需有 x2/(4κt) 约为 1，这给出热量主要分布的距离。

    For a non-negligible exponential, x2/(4κt) must be about 1, which gives the main spreading distance.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    x2/(4κt)~1 给出 |x|~2κt，所以分布随时间变宽。

    x2/(4κt)~1 gives |x|~2κt, so the distribution widens with time.

做完以后这样检查Check after solving

  • 守恒：∫−∞∞u(x,t)dx=1，与单位初始总量相同。

    Conservation: ∫−∞∞u(x,t)dx=1, equal to the unit initial amount.

  • 方程：直接求导可得 Kt=κKxx。

    Equation: direct differentiation gives Kt=κKxx.

  • 趋势：峰值 t−1/2 降低而宽度 t 增大，两者配合保持总量不变。

    Trend: the peak falls like t−1/2 while the width grows like t, and together they preserve the total amount.

学完试一题：合上例题，自己做Try it yourself: close the worked example＋

先独立写第一步。卡住时只开一个提示，做完再核对答案。Write your first step independently. Open one hint if stuck; check the solution after attempting the problem.

全轴热方程为 ut=uxx，x∈R、t>0，初值为 u(x,0)=e−x2。用热核卷积求解，并判断总热量是否守恒。可使用高斯积分 ∫Re−a(s−b)2ds=π/a，其中 a>0。

Solve the whole-line heat equation ut=uxx for x∈R, t>0, with u(x,0)=e−x2, using convolution with the heat kernel. Determine whether total heat is conserved. You may use ∫Re−a(s−b)2ds=π/a for a>0.

提示 1：先选方法Hint 1: choose a method＋

写卷积 u=14πt∫Re−(x−s)2/(4t)−s2ds。

Write the convolution u=14πt∫Re−(x−s)2/(4t)−s2ds.

提示 2：写第一行Hint 2: write the first line＋

配方：(x−s)24t+s2=1+4t4t(s−x1+4t)2+x21+4t。

Complete the square: (x−s)24t+s2=1+4t4t(s−x1+4t)2+x21+4t.

提示 3：关键计算Hint 3: key calculation＋

高斯积分产生因子 4πt/(1+4t)，与卷积前系数相乘。

The Gaussian integral contributes 4πt/(1+4t); multiply this by the prefactor of the convolution.

展开分步完整解答Open the full step-by-step solution＋

热核为 G(z,t)=(4πt)−1/2e−z2/(4t)。

初值光滑可积，卷积给出 u=14πt∫Re−(x−s)2/(4t)−s2ds。

合并指数后配方为 (x−s)24t+s2=1+4t4t(s−x1+4t)2+x21+4t。

后一项不含积分变量，可以先提出积分号外。

使用给定高斯积分，得到 u(x,t)=11+4texp[−x2/(1+4t)]。

令 t↓0 恢复初值；随时间增大，峰值降低，曲线变宽。

再对空间积分，令 z=x/1+4t，系数恰好与换元的雅可比相消，故 ∫Ru(x,t)dx=∫Re−z2dz=π。

总热量与初始值相同。

The heat kernel is G(z,t)=(4πt)−1/2e−z2/(4t).

The initial function is smooth and integrable, so convolution gives u=14πt∫Re−(x−s)2/(4t)−s2ds.

Combining exponents and completing the square gives (x−s)24t+s2=1+4t4t(s−x1+4t)2+x21+4t.

The last term is independent of the integration variable and can be taken outside the integral.

Using the stated Gaussian integral yields u(x,t)=11+4texp[−x2/(1+4t)].

Taking t↓0 recovers the initial data.

As time increases, the peak falls and the profile broadens.

Integrate over space using z=x/1+4t.

The prefactor cancels the Jacobian, giving ∫Ru(x,t)dx=∫Re−z2dz=π.

Total heat equals its initial value.

怎样检查，哪里容易错Check your result and common mistakes＋

对所得表达式求导可检验 ut=uxx，并用初值极限与总热量双重检查。典型错误是只保留指数的变宽，却漏掉峰值前的归一化因子。

Differentiate the result to verify ut=uxx, and check both the initial limit and total heat. A common error is to broaden the exponential but omit the normalizing factor that lowers the peak.

记忆线索Memory cue

热核总量为 1；零值边界相减，零导数边界相加。

The heat kernel has total mass 1. Subtract images for a zero value; add them for a zero derivative.

知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

非齐次边界先齐次化Make nonhomogeneous boundaries homogeneous first

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

端点不为零时，直接套零边界的正弦展开会失败。先减去一个满足边界的简单函数，让剩下的未知量在端点为零。

For nonzero boundary data, subtract a simple function that already satisfies the boundary. The remainder then has zero boundary values and can use the standard expansion.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

直接分离变量要求齐次边界。先找一个满足边界的简单函数 h，再令 u=v+h。若边界随时间变，v 的方程通常出现新的源项。

Direct separation of variables needs homogeneous boundaries. First choose a simple function h satisfying the prescribed boundary values, then set u=v+h. If the boundary changes with time, the equation for v usually acquires a new source.

u=v+h,vt−κvxx=f−(ht−κhxx)
使用条件When it applies

例如 u(0,t)=A(t)、u(L,t)=B(t) 可选 h=A+(B−A)x/L。v 的边界为零，但初值必须同时减 h(x,0)。

For example, with u(0,t)=A(t) and u(L,t)=B(t), choose h=A+(B−A)x/L. The boundary values of v are zero, but its initial data must also have h(x,0) subtracted.

展开分步证明 / 推导Open the step-by-step proof / derivation＋

若 u(0,t)=A(t)、u(L,t)=B(t)，先选能连接两端的直线 h(x,t)=A(t)+[B(t)−A(t)]x/L。

定义 v=u−h，立刻得到 v(0,t)=v(L,t)=0；此时才适合使用零边界本征函数。

原方程写成 ut−κuxx=f。

代入 u=v+h 并逐项移项，得 vt−κvxx=f−ht+κhxx=f−(ht−κhxx)；不允许只改边界而不改方程。

初值也要同时处理：若 u(x,0)=φ(x)，则 v(x,0)=φ(x)−h(x,0)。

对连接直线有 hxx=0；若边界随时间变，ht=A′+(B′−A′)x/L 一般不为零，会变成新源项。

边界为常数时 ht=hxx=0，线性提升不新增源。

更一般地，若先找到满足恒定源和边界的稳态 U，减去 U 还能同时消除源项；最后始终要把提升函数加回去。

For u(0,t)=A(t) and u(L,t)=B(t), choose the connecting line h(x,t)=A(t)+[B(t)−A(t)]x/L.

Defining v=u−h gives v(0,t)=v(L,t)=0, allowing a zero-boundary eigenfunction expansion.

Write the equation as ut−κuxx=f.

Substitution of u=v+h gives vt−κvxx=f−ht+κhxx=f−(ht−κhxx).

Changing the boundary without changing the equation is insufficient.

Adjust initial data too: if u(x,0)=φ(x), then v(x,0)=φ(x)−h(x,0).

The connecting line has hxx=0, but time-dependent boundaries usually give nonzero ht=A′+(B′−A′)x/L, creating a new source.

For constant boundaries, ht=hxx=0, so linear lifting adds no source.

More generally, find a steady state U that satisfies the source and boundaries; subtracting U removes both at once.

Always add the lifting function back at the end.

做一道简单例题：按步骤看计算Worked example: follow each calculation＋
题目Problem

细杆 0<x<L 满足 ut=κuxx，端点温度为 u(0,t)=0、u(L,t)=T，初温 u(x,0)=0。求 u(x,t) 及其稳态。

A thin rod on 0<x<L satisfies ut=κuxx, with endpoint temperatures u(0,t)=0 and u(L,t)=T, and initial temperature u(x,0)=0. Find u(x,t) and its steady state.

已知什么Given

这里 T 是常数端点温度，κ>0 是热扩散率；初始角点 (L,0) 的数据不相容，初值按杆内部理解。

Here T is the constant endpoint temperature and κ>0 is thermal diffusivity; the data conflict at the initial corner (L,0), so interpret the initial value inside the rod.

要求什么Find

先把非齐次边界变成零边界，再求 u(x,t) 并取 t→∞。

First turn the nonhomogeneous boundary into zero boundary data, then find u(x,t) and take t→∞.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1选边界函数Choose a boundary function
    为什么这样做Why this step

    先找一个简单函数单独承担两端温度，剩余未知量就能使用正弦展开。

    First find a simple function that carries both endpoint temperatures, so the remaining unknown can use a sine expansion.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    取 h(x)=Tx/L，它满足 h(0)=0、h(L)=T，并且 h″(x)=0。

    Take h(x)=Tx/L; it satisfies h(0)=0, h(L)=T, and h″(x)=0.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2换成零边界Create zero boundaries
    为什么这样做Why this step

    令 v=u−h 后，h 吸收了非零端点值。

    After setting v=u−h, the function h absorbs the nonzero endpoint value.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    vt=κvxx，v(0,t)=v(L,t)=0，而 v(x,0)=−Tx/L。

    vt=κvxx, v(0,t)=v(L,t)=0, and v(x,0)=−Tx/L.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3投影初值Project the initial value
    为什么这样做Why this step

    零边界使用 sin(nπx/L)；系数由正交积分给出。

    Zero boundary data use sin(nπx/L), and orthogonality gives each coefficient.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    bn=2L∫0L(−Tx/L)sin(nπx/L)dx=−2TL2In，其中 In=∫0Lxsin(nπx/L)dx。

    bn=2L∫0L(−Tx/L)sin(nπx/L)dx=−2TL2In, where In=∫0Lxsin(nπx/L)dx.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4算清积分Evaluate the integral
    为什么这样做Why this step

    分部积分能把 In 化成端点值，避免跳过符号。

    Integration by parts reduces In to endpoint values and makes the sign explicit.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    In=[−Lxnπcos(nπx/L)+L2n2π2sin(nπx/L)]0L=−L2(−1)nnπ，故 bn=2T(−1)nnπ。

    In=[−Lxnπcos(nπx/L)+L2n2π2sin(nπx/L)]0L=−L2(−1)nnπ, hence bn=2T(−1)nnπ.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5组合并取极限Combine and take the limit
    为什么这样做Why this step

    每个正弦模态按自己的热方程因子衰减，最后只留下边界函数。

    Each sine mode decays by its heat-equation factor, so only the boundary function remains at long times.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    u(x,t)=TxL+∑n=1∞2T(−1)nnπe−κ(nπ/L)2tsin(nπx/L)，且 u(x,t)→Tx/L。

    u(x,t)=TxL+∑n=1∞2T(−1)nnπe−κ(nπ/L)2tsin(nπx/L), and u(x,t)→Tx/L.

做完以后这样检查Check after solving

  • 边界：正弦项在 x=0,L 为零，所以 u(0,t)=0、u(L,t)=T。

    Boundary: every sine term vanishes at x=0,L, so u(0,t)=0 and u(L,t)=T.

  • 方程：Tx/L 的二阶导数为零，每个级数项都满足 ut=κuxx。

    Equation: the second derivative of Tx/L is zero, and every series term satisfies ut=κuxx.

  • 稳态：当 t→∞ 时所有指数项趋于零，只剩 Tx/L。

    Steady state: as t→∞, all exponential terms vanish, leaving Tx/L.

学完试一题：合上例题，自己做Try it yourself: close the worked example＋

先独立写第一步。卡住时只开一个提示，做完再核对答案。Write your first step independently. Open one hint if stuck; check the solution after attempting the problem.

在 0<x<1、t>0 上，求 ut=uxx+2，边界为 u(0,t)=2t、u(1,t)=2t+1，初值为 u(x,0)=x+sin(πx)。请写出边界齐次化后的方程和初值，再求解。

For 0<x<1, t>0, solve ut=uxx+2 with u(0,t)=2t, u(1,t)=2t+1, and u(x,0)=x+sin(πx). Write the equation and initial data after making the boundaries homogeneous, then solve it.

提示 1：先选方法Hint 1: choose a method＋

用连接两端值的直线 h(x,t)=2t+x，令 v=u−h。

Use the line joining the boundary values, h(x,t)=2t+x, and set v=u−h.

提示 2：写第一行Hint 2: write the first line＋

注意 ht=2、hxx=0，所以 vt=vxx+2+hxx−ht=vxx。

Note that ht=2 and hxx=0, so vt=vxx+2+hxx−ht=vxx.

提示 3：关键计算Hint 3: key calculation＋

初值也要减去 h(x,0)=x，留下 v(x,0)=sin(πx)。

Subtract h(x,0)=x from the initial data as well, leaving v(x,0)=sin(πx).

展开分步完整解答Open the full step-by-step solution＋
  1. 第 1 步Step 1

    选择 h=2t+x，它同时满足两端给定温度。

    Choose h=2t+x, which matches the prescribed temperatures at both ends.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2

    令 v=u−h，因此 v(0,t)=v(1,t)=0。

    Set v=u−h, so v(0,t)=v(1,t)=0.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3

    边界齐次化只保证边界变为零，还必须重新计算方程。

    Making the boundaries zero is only the first step; the differential equation must also be recalculated.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4

    把 u=v+h 代入得 vt+ht=vxx+hxx+2。

    Substitute u=v+h to obtain vt+ht=vxx+hxx+2.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5

    由于 ht=2、hxx=0，本题恰好化为 vt=vxx。

    Since ht=2 and hxx=0, this particular problem reduces to vt=vxx.

  6. 第 6 步Step 6

    若没有原来的热源项，时间变化的边界本身就会留下一个非零源项。

    Without the original heat source, the time-dependent boundary lifting would itself leave a nonzero forcing term.

  7. 第 7 步Step 7

    初值变为 v(x,0)=x+sin(πx)−x=sin(πx)。

    The initial data become v(x,0)=x+sin(πx)−x=sin(πx).

  8. 第 8 步Step 8

    设 v=b(t)sin(πx)，得到 b′=−π2b、b(0)=1，故 v=e−π2tsin(πx)。

    Set v=b(t)sin(πx) to obtain b′=−π2b and b(0)=1, hence v=e−π2tsin(πx).

  9. 第 9 步Step 9

    加回连接函数，最终 u(x,t)=2t+x+e−π2tsin(πx)。

    Add the lifting function back to obtain u(x,t)=2t+x+e−π2tsin(πx).

  10. 第 10 步Step 10

    本题初值、边界及方程在角点也相容，有限模态表达式可直接作为光滑经典解。

    The initial data, boundaries, and equation are compatible at the corners, so this finite-mode expression is directly a smooth classical solution.

怎样检查，哪里容易错Check your result and common mistakes＋

分别检查两端温度、初温和 ut−uxx=2。典型错误是忘记初值减去连接函数，或者忘记方程中的 −ht。

Check the endpoint temperatures, initial temperature, and ut−uxx=2 separately. Common errors are forgetting to subtract the lifting function from the initial data or omitting −ht from the transformed equation.

记忆线索Memory cue

边界先减掉；初值也减掉；方程检查是否新增源。

Subtract the boundary function. Subtract it from the initial data too. Check whether the equation gains a source.

SECTION 3.3 · 教材 p.151SECTION 3.3 · Textbook p.151

稳定场问题Steady fields

练习这一节 →Practice this section →
知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

稳定场问题：方程与边界一起看Steady fields: read the equation and boundaries together

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

稳定场不再随时间变化。先找区域形状，再让分离出的每个因子满足对应边界；最后用边界上的函数确定系数。

A steady field no longer changes with time. Use the region’s geometry to separate variables, enforce the boundary conditions, and determine coefficients from the boundary data.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

稳态意味着时间不变，无源场满足拉普拉斯方程。矩形区域分离后，一个方向是三角函数，另一个方向是双曲函数；非齐次边界通过投影确定系数。

A steady field does not depend on time. A source-free steady field satisfies Laplace’s equation. On a rectangle, separation gives trigonometric functions in one direction and hyperbolic functions in the other. Project the nonzero boundary values to find coefficients.

Δu=0,X″+λX=0,Y″−λY=0
使用条件When it applies

无源矩形区域；用齐次边界所在方向决定正交基，再满足非齐次边界。

A source-free rectangular region. Choose the orthogonal basis using the homogeneous boundaries, then satisfy the nonhomogeneous boundary.

展开分步证明 / 推导Open the step-by-step proof / derivation＋

无源稳态不再随时间变化，满足 uxx+uyy=0。

令 u=X(x)Y(y)，代入后分离得 X″/X=−Y″/Y=−λ，所以一边满足 X″+λX=0，另一边满足 Y″−λY=0。

若左右两边为零，X(0)=X(a)=0 选出 Xn=sin(knx)、kn=nπ/a。

对应 Yn′′−kn2Yn=0，因此其一般解是 Csinh(kny)+Dcosh(kny)，不是另一套普通正弦。

底边为零使 D=0；顶边给 f(x)，应把竖向因子除以 sinh(knb)，使其在顶边为 1。

再用 fn=2a∫0af(x)sin(knx)dx，得到 u=∑fnsin(knx)sinh(kny)/sinh(knb)。

检查时将顶边代入，看双曲比值是否消成 1。

若非零边给的是导数，应归一其导数而非函数值；若几条边非零，可用线性叠加拆成多个单边问题，并检查角点数据是否相容。

A source-free steady field satisfies uxx+uyy=0.

With u=X(x)Y(y), separation gives X″/X=−Y″/Y=−λ, hence X″+λX=0 and Y″−λY=0.

Zero left and right values give X(0)=X(a)=0, selecting Xn=sin(knx) with kn=nπ/a.

Then Yn′′−kn2Yn=0, whose general solution is Csinh(kny)+Dcosh(kny) rather than an ordinary sine.

A zero bottom sets D=0.

For top data f(x), divide the vertical factor by sinh(knb) so it equals 1 there.

With fn=2a∫0af(x)sin(knx)dx, obtain u=∑fnsin(knx)sinh(kny)/sinh(knb).

Check the top boundary by confirming the hyperbolic ratio becomes 1.

If a boundary prescribes a derivative, normalize that derivative instead of the value.

Multiple nonzero edges can be split by superposition, with corner compatibility checked separately.

做一道简单例题：按步骤看计算Worked example: follow each calculation＋
题目Problem

在矩形 0<x<a、0<y<b 内解 uxx+uyy=0。边界为 u(0,y)=u(a,y)=u(x,0)=0，u(x,b)=sin(πx/a)。

In the rectangle 0<x<a, 0<y<b, solve uxx+uyy=0. The boundaries are u(0,y)=u(a,y)=u(x,0)=0 and u(x,b)=sin(πx/a).

已知什么Given

这里 u(x,y) 是稳定场；三条边为零，只有顶边给出一个正弦分布。

Here u(x,y) is a steady field; three sides are zero, and only the top side has a sine profile.

要求什么Find

用分离变量求出 u(x,y)，并逐边检查四个边界条件。

Use separation of variables to find u(x,y) and check all four boundary conditions one by one.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1分离变量Separate variables
    为什么这样做Why this step

    矩形边界与乘积形状相配，设 u=X(x)Y(y) 可把偏微分方程拆成两个常微分方程。

    The rectangular boundaries fit a product form, so setting u=X(x)Y(y) splits the partial differential equation into two ordinary differential equations.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    X″/X=−Y″/Y=−λ，所以 X″+λX=0、Y″−λY=0。

    X″/X=−Y″/Y=−λ, so X″+λX=0 and Y″−λY=0.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2满足左右边Satisfy the side boundaries
    为什么这样做Why this step

    X(0)=X(a)=0 选出正弦本征函数和离散波数。

    X(0)=X(a)=0 selects sine eigenfunctions and discrete wave numbers.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    Xn(x)=sin(nπx/a)，波数为 kn=nπ/a。

    Xn(x)=sin(nπx/a), with wave number kn=nπ/a.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3满足底边Satisfy the bottom boundary
    为什么这样做Why this step

    Y(0)=0 要去掉双曲余弦，只留下在零点为零的双曲正弦。

    Y(0)=0 removes the hyperbolic cosine and leaves the hyperbolic sine, which vanishes at zero.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    Yn(y)=Cnsinh(kny)；把顶边归一化后写成 Yn(y)=sinh(kny)/sinh(knb)。

    Yn(y)=Cnsinh(kny); after normalization at the top, write Yn(y)=sinh(kny)/sinh(knb).

  4. 第 4 步Step 4匹配顶边Match the top boundary
    为什么这样做Why this step

    顶边数据本身就是 n=1 的正弦，所以其他模态系数全为零。

    The top data is already the sine mode n=1, so every other modal coefficient is zero.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    取 k1=π/a，得到 u(x,y)=sin(πx/a)sinh(πy/a)sinh(πb/a)。

    With k1=π/a, one gets u(x,y)=sin(πx/a)sinh(πy/a)sinh(πb/a).

做完以后这样检查Check after solving

  • 方程：令 k=π/a，则 uxx=−k2u、uyy=k2u，两者相加为零。

    Equation: let k=π/a; then uxx=−k2u and uyy=k2u, so their sum is zero.

  • 三条零边：在 x=0,a 时正弦为零，在 y=0 时 sinh(0)=0。

    Three zero sides: the sine vanishes at x=0,a; at y=0, one has sinh(0)=0.

  • 顶边：令 y=b，分子分母相同，得到 u(x,b)=sin(πx/a)。

    Top side: setting y=b makes numerator and denominator equal, giving u(x,b)=sin(πx/a).

学完试一题：合上例题，自己做Try it yourself: close the worked example＋

先独立写第一步。卡住时只开一个提示，做完再核对答案。Write your first step independently. Open one hint if stuck; check the solution after attempting the problem.

在矩形 0<x<π、0<y<1 内求 uxx+uyy=0；左右边界及底边温度均为零，顶边为 u(x,1)=2sin(2x)。要求解连续到闭矩形且内部光滑。

Solve uxx+uyy=0 in the rectangle 0<x<π, 0<y<1. The left, right, and bottom boundaries have zero temperature, and the top boundary is u(x,1)=2sin(2x). Seek a solution continuous on the closed rectangle and smooth inside.

提示 1：先选方法Hint 1: choose a method＋

顶边只含一个正弦模态，先设 u=Y(y)sin(2x)。

The top boundary contains just one sine mode, so set u=Y(y)sin(2x).

提示 2：写第一行Hint 2: write the first line＋

方程给 Y″−4Y=0；底边条件为 Y(0)=0。

The equation gives Y″−4Y=0; the bottom boundary requires Y(0)=0.

提示 3：关键计算Hint 3: key calculation＋

留下 Y=Csinh(2y)，再用 Y(1)=2 求出常数。

This leaves Y=Csinh(2y); use Y(1)=2 to determine the constant.

展开分步完整解答Open the full step-by-step solution＋

左右边界均为零，而顶边已经写成 2sin(2x)，因此不需要计算完整傅里叶级数，只取这个空间模态：u=Y(y)sin(2x)。

代入拉普拉斯方程得 (Y″−4Y)sin(2x)=0，于是 Y″−4Y=0。

通解为 Y=Acosh(2y)+Bsinh(2y)；底边给 A=0。

顶边要求 Bsinh2=2，所以 u(x,y)=2sinh(2y)sinh2sin(2x)。

顶边在两个角点也为零，和相邻侧边相容；所得函数连续到边界。

Both side boundaries are zero and the top boundary is already 2sin(2x), so no full Fourier expansion is needed.

Use this single spatial mode: u=Y(y)sin(2x).

Substitution into Laplace's equation gives (Y″−4Y)sin(2x)=0, hence Y″−4Y=0.

Its general solution is Y=Acosh(2y)+Bsinh(2y); the bottom boundary gives A=0.

The top boundary requires Bsinh2=2, so u(x,y)=2sinh(2y)sinh2sin(2x).

The top data vanish at both corners and agree with the adjacent side boundaries; the result is continuous up to the boundary.

怎样检查，哪里容易错Check your result and common mistakes＋

检查 uxx=−4u、uyy=4u，然后逐边代入。典型错误是把纵向函数也写成普通正弦，忘记拉普拉斯方程分离后两个方向的符号相反。

Check uxx=−4u and uyy=4u, then substitute each boundary. A common error is to use an ordinary sine in the vertical direction as well, overlooking the opposite signs of the separated equations for Laplace's equation.

记忆线索Memory cue

先用齐次两边选正交基，再用双曲函数跨到非零边。

Use two homogeneous sides to choose the orthogonal basis, then a hyperbolic factor to reach the nonzero side.

知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

Laplace 方程的唯一性与最大值原理Uniqueness and the maximum principle for Laplace’s equation

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

算出一个解以后，还要知道是否可能有另一个解。比较两个解的差，并结合边界条件，能证明差只能为零。

After finding a solution, ask whether another one could exist. Subtract two candidate solutions and use their zero difference on the boundary to prove uniqueness.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

边界值不仅用来定系数，也决定解是否唯一。判断两种方法的结果是否相同，可以研究两解之差。

Boundary values do more than fix coefficients: they determine whether the solution is unique. To compare results from two methods, study their difference.

Δw=0,w|∂V=0⟹w≡0
使用条件When it applies

有界连通域、足够正则的调和函数及 Dirichlet 边界。外域必须给无穷远条件。纯 Neumann 问题只确定到常数，且要有相容条件。

A bounded connected domain, sufficiently regular harmonic functions, and Dirichlet boundaries. An exterior domain also requires behavior at infinity. A pure Neumann problem determines the solution only up to a constant and requires compatibility.

展开分步证明 / 推导Open the step-by-step proof / derivation＋

若 u1,u2 满足同一 Dirichlet 问题，令 w=u1−u2。

由方程和边界的线性性，Δw=0 且 w|∂V=0；证明唯一性就变成证明这个齐次问题只有零解。

利用散度恒等式 ∇·(w∇w)=|∇w|2+wΔw，积分并用散度定理得到 ∫V|∇w|2dV=∮∂Vw∂nwdS−∫VwΔwdV。

零边界使第一项为零，调和性使第二项为零。

非负函数 |∇w|2 的积分为零，足够正则时推出 ∇w=0；连通域内 w 是常数，再由零边界定为零。

若是纯 Neumann 边界，只能定到常数；还必须满足总通量相容条件。

最大值原理给另一条判断途径：调和函数的球面平均等于中心值；若内部取得严格最大值，平均不可能仍等于该最大值，除非邻域都取相同值，连通性再使全域常值。

这是平均值性质推出强最大值原理的核心思路，并非平均值性质本身的完整证明；外域还要给无穷远条件。

If u1,u2 solve the same Dirichlet problem, set w=u1−u2.

Linearity gives Δw=0 and w|∂V=0, reducing uniqueness to proving the homogeneous problem has only the zero solution.

Use ∇·(w∇w)=|∇w|2+wΔw and the divergence theorem to obtain ∫V|∇w|2dV=∮∂Vw∂nwdS−∫VwΔwdV.

Zero boundary data remove the first term and harmonicity removes the second.

A zero integral of the nonnegative quantity |∇w|2 implies ∇w=0 under sufficient regularity.

On a connected domain w is constant, and zero boundary data make it zero.

Pure Neumann data determine only an additive constant and also require total-flux compatibility.

The maximum principle offers another route: a harmonic function's spherical average equals its central value.

An interior maximum can equal that average only if neighboring values agree; connectedness then forces a constant field.

This is the core argument from the mean-value property, not a full proof of that property.

Exterior domains additionally need a condition at infinity.

做一道简单例题：按步骤看计算Worked example: follow each calculation＋
题目Problem

球域 Ω 内没有热源，故 Δu=0；球面 ∂Ω 上温度恒为 u=5。球心温度能否高于 5？

There is no heat source in the ball Ω, so Δu=0; the temperature on the sphere ∂Ω is the constant u=5. Can the center temperature exceed 5?

已知什么Given

这里 u 是稳定温度，Δ 是拉普拉斯算子；边界上每一点都给出同一个数值。

Here u is steady temperature and Δ is the Laplacian; every point of the boundary is assigned the same value.

要求什么Find

先找到一个解，再用唯一性或最大值原理判断球内全部温度。

First find one solution, then use uniqueness or the maximum principle to determine the temperature everywhere inside the ball.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1先试常数解Try a constant solution
    为什么这样做Why this step

    边界值是常数，最简单的候选就是把这个常数延伸到整个球内。

    Because the boundary value is constant, the simplest candidate extends that constant throughout the ball.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    令 u*(x)=5，则 Δu*=0，并且在 ∂Ω 上有 u*=5。

    Set u*(x)=5; then Δu*=0, and on ∂Ω one has u*=5.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2构造解的差Form the difference
    为什么这样做Why this step

    要证明没有别的解，把任意解与已知解相减就得到零边界问题。

    To rule out another solution, subtract the known solution from any solution and obtain a zero-boundary problem.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    令 w=u−u*，则 Δw=0，且在 ∂Ω 上 w=0。

    Let w=u−u*; then Δw=0, and on ∂Ω one has w=0.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3使用能量恒等式Use the energy identity
    为什么这样做Why this step

    零边界会让分部积分的边界项消失，从而控制梯度。

    The zero boundary makes the boundary term from integration by parts vanish, which controls the gradient.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    ∫Ω|∇w|2dV=∫∂Ωw∂nwdS−∫ΩwΔwdV=0。

  4. 第 4 步Step 4得出唯一解Conclude uniqueness
    为什么这样做Why this step

    非负函数 |∇w|2 的积分为零，只能有 ∇w=0；再用零边界确定常数。

    The nonnegative function |∇w|2 has zero integral, so ∇w=0; the zero boundary then fixes the constant.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    w=0，所以 u(x)=5 在整个 Ω 内成立，球心也只能是 5。

    w=0, so u(x)=5 throughout Ω, and the center value is 5.

做完以后这样检查Check after solving

  • 代回：常函数 u=5 的所有二阶导数为零，所以 Δu=0。

    Substitution: every second derivative of the constant function u=5 is zero, so Δu=0.

  • 边界：在 ∂Ω 上仍有 u=5。

    Boundary: on ∂Ω, one still has u=5.

  • 最大值原理：maxΩu≤5 且 minΩu≥5，与 u=5 一致。

    Maximum principle: maxΩu≤5 and minΩu≥5, consistent with u=5.

学完试一题：合上例题，自己做Try it yourself: close the worked example＋

先独立写第一步。卡住时只开一个提示，做完再核对答案。Write your first step independently. Open one hint if stuck; check the solution after attempting the problem.

令 B={x∈R3:|x|<2}。在球内 Δu=0，且 u∈C2(B)∩C(B―)。若球面上 u=7，求球内温度并证明唯一。再判断：若改成光滑解满足球面上 ∂nu=0，是否仍能唯一确定温度？

Let B={x∈R3:|x|<2}. Suppose Δu=0 in the ball and u∈C2(B)∩C(B―). If u=7 on the sphere, determine the interior temperature and prove uniqueness. Then decide whether replacing this with a smooth solution satisfying ∂nu=0 on the sphere still determines a unique temperature.

提示 1：先选方法Hint 1: choose a method＋

常数 u=7 是一个候选解；要证明唯一，可以对两个候选解作差。

The constant u=7 is a candidate solution. To prove uniqueness, consider the difference of two candidates.

提示 2：写第一行Hint 2: write the first line＋

差函数 w=u−7 调和且边界为零，分别对 w 和 −w 用最大值原理。

The difference w=u−7 is harmonic with zero boundary data. Apply the maximum principle to both w and −w.

提示 3：关键计算Hint 3: key calculation＋

零法向导数允许任意常数 u=C；仅给绝热边界没有规定平均温度。

Zero normal derivative permits any constant u=C; insulated boundary data alone do not prescribe the mean temperature.

展开分步完整解答Open the full step-by-step solution＋

常数函数 u=7 的拉普拉斯算子为零，而且满足边界，所以存在一个解。

接下来不是猜测中心温度，而是排除任何其他可能解。

令 w=u−7，则 Δw=0，球面上 w=0。

有界球域上的最大值原理给 w≤0；对 −w 再用一次，得 −w≤0。

因此 w=0，球内唯一温度为 u=7。

若边界改成 ∂nu=0，每个常数 u=C 都满足方程与边界，因此不能唯一确定绝对温度。

对光滑解，用格林恒等式可得 ∫B|∇u|2dV=∫∂Bu∂nudS−∫BuΔudV=0，故连通球域中的解确实都是常数。

本题的零通量满足 Neumann 相容条件；但还需要指定一个平均温度，才能在常数族中选定唯一解。

证明“只差一个常数”和证明“唯一”是不同结论。

The constant function u=7 has zero Laplacian and satisfies the boundary data, so a solution exists.

The next step is to exclude other solutions rather than guess the temperature at the center.

Set w=u−7.

Then Δw=0 and w=0 on the sphere.

The maximum principle in the bounded ball gives w≤0.

Applying it to −w gives −w≤0.

Thus w=0, and the unique interior temperature is u=7.

If the boundary is instead ∂nu=0, every constant u=C satisfies both the equation and the boundary, so the absolute temperature is not uniquely determined.

For a smooth solution, Green's identity gives ∫B|∇u|2dV=∫∂Bu∂nudS−∫BuΔudV=0, so the solutions on the connected ball are indeed all constants.

The zero-flux data satisfy the Neumann compatibility condition.

A prescribed mean temperature is still needed to select one solution from the constant family.

Uniqueness up to an additive constant and absolute uniqueness are different conclusions.

怎样检查，哪里容易错Check your result and common mistakes＋

把 u=7 代入原题即可验证存在；第二问用 u=0 与 u=1 两个不同解直接检验不唯一。典型错误是把 Dirichlet 唯一性原样套到纯 Neumann 问题。

Substitute u=7 to verify existence in the original problem. For the second question, the distinct solutions u=0 and u=1 directly verify nonuniqueness. A common error is to transfer Dirichlet uniqueness unchanged to a pure Neumann problem.

SECTION 3.4 · 教材 p.160SECTION 3.4 · Textbook p.160

施图姆–刘维尔本征值问题Sturm–Liouville eigenvalue problems

练习这一节 →Practice this section →
知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

施图姆–刘维尔本征值问题：方程与边界一起看Sturm–Liouville problems: read the equation and boundaries together

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

只有某些参数能让非零函数同时满足方程和两端边界，这些参数叫本征值。先分正、零、负三种情况，不要默认只有正值。

An eigenvalue is a parameter allowing a nonzero solution to satisfy the equation and both boundaries. Examine positive, zero, and negative cases separately.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

不同边界下看似不同的级数，统一来自自伴本征值问题。权函数决定投影内积。实本征值依赖自伴边界；本征值非负还需要能量二次型非负，不能只看微分方程系数。

The different series arising from different boundaries all come from self-adjoint eigenvalue problems. The weight function defines the projection inner product. Self-adjoint boundaries ensure real eigenvalues. Nonnegative eigenvalues additionally require a nonnegative energy quadratic form; the differential-equation coefficients alone do not guarantee this.

(py′)′−qy+λwy=0,⟨f,g⟩w=∫abwfg―dx
使用条件When it applies

正则情形 p>0,w>0、q 实，配实分离自伴边界；奇异端点需额外有限性/可积性条件。

In the regular case, p>0,w>0, q is real, and separated real self-adjoint boundary conditions are imposed. Singular endpoints need additional finiteness or integrability conditions.

展开分步证明 / 推导Open the step-by-step proof / derivation＋

写第 m 支方程 (pym′)′−qym+λmwym=0。

把它乘 yn―，再减去第 n 支共轭方程乘 ym；q 为实数，所以含 q 的项完全抵消。

积分并把导数项合成边界项，得 (λm−λn―)∫abwymyn―dx=−[p(ym′yn―−ymyn′―)]ab。

实分离边界使右端为零：端点要么 y=0，要么 y′ 是同一实常数乘 y。

先取 m=n，因 w>0 且本征函数非零，∫abw|yn|2dx>0，所以 λn=λn―。

再取不同本征值，差不为零，只能有 ∫abwymyn―dx=0，即带权正交。

投影必须使用同一个权：an=⟨f,yn⟩w/⟨yn,yn⟩w。

实谱和正交性不等于非负谱；能量商的分子为 ∫(p|y′|2+q|y|2)dx−[py′y¯]ab，Robin 边界贡献可能为负。

这里证明的是正则自伴问题的实谱与不同本征值正交。

奇异端点须另证边界项消失；完备性、展开收敛等更强结论需要额外定理，不能只凭这条恒等式全部断言。

Write equation m as (pym′)′−qym+λmwym=0.

Multiply by yn― and subtract the conjugate of equation n multiplied by ym.

Since q is real, the terms involving q cancel.

Integrating gives (λm−λn―)∫abwymyn―dx=−[p(ym′yn―−ymyn′―)]ab.

Real separated conditions make this zero: an endpoint has either y=0 or y′ equal to the same real multiple of y.

First set m=n.

Since w>0 and the eigenfunction is nonzero, ∫abw|yn|2dx>0, giving λn=λn―.

For different eigenvalues, their nonzero difference forces ∫abwymyn―dx=0, proving weighted orthogonality.

Projection must use the same weight: an=⟨f,yn⟩w/⟨yn,yn⟩w.

Reality and orthogonality do not imply nonnegative eigenvalues: the energy numerator is ∫(p|y′|2+q|y|2)dx−[py′y¯]ab, and Robin boundaries can contribute negatively.

This proves reality and orthogonality for a regular self-adjoint problem.

Singular endpoints require a separate boundary-term argument; completeness and expansion convergence need additional theorems rather than this identity alone.

做一道简单例题：按步骤看计算Worked example: follow each calculation＋
题目Problem

在 x>0 上，把 xy″+(1−x)y′+ay=0 写成施图姆–刘维尔自伴形式。

On x>0, put xy″+(1−x)y′+ay=0 into Sturm–Liouville self-adjoint form.

已知什么Given

目标标准形为 (py′)′+(λw−q)y=0；其中 p 是导数项系数，w 是权函数。

The target standard form is (py′)′+(λw−q)y=0; here p is the derivative coefficient and w is the weight function.

要求什么Find

找出乘子，并明确写出 p(x)、q(x)、w(x) 和 λ。

Find the multiplier and state p(x), q(x), w(x), and λ explicitly.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1观察总导数Look for a total derivative
    为什么这样做Why this step

    要把前两项合成 (py′)′，y″ 的系数和 y′ 的系数必须分别是 p 和 p′。

    To combine the first two terms into (py′)′, the coefficients of y″ and y′ must be p and p′, respectively.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    因为 (xe−x)′=(1−x)e−x，乘上 e−x 后正好出现所需的一对系数。

    Because (xe−x)′=(1−x)e−x, multiplication by e−x creates exactly the required pair of coefficients.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2乘上因子Apply the multiplier
    为什么这样做Why this step

    对原方程每一项都乘 e−x，解集不变，因为 e−x>0。

    Multiply every term by e−x; the solution set is unchanged because e−x>0.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    xe−xy″+(1−x)e−xy′+ae−xy=0。

  3. 第 3 步Step 3合并导数项Combine derivative terms
    为什么这样做Why this step

    乘积求导公式给出 (xe−xy′)′=xe−xy″+(1−x)e−xy′。

    The product rule gives (xe−xy′)′=xe−xy″+(1−x)e−xy′.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    因此方程变为 (xe−xy′)′+ae−xy=0。

    Thus the equation becomes (xe−xy′)′+ae−xy=0.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4对照标准形Match the standard form
    为什么这样做Why this step

    把参数 a 放在 λw 的位置，就能逐项读出四个量。

    Place the parameter a in the position of λw, and then read off all four quantities.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    p(x)=xe−x、q(x)=0、w(x)=e−x、λ=a。

做完以后这样检查Check after solving

  • 展开：(xe−xy′)′=xe−xy″+(1−x)e−xy′，与乘因子后的前两项相同。

    Expansion: (xe−xy′)′=xe−xy″+(1−x)e−xy′, matching the first two multiplied terms.

  • 除回：自伴方程除以 e−x 后恢复 xy″+(1−x)y′+ay=0。

    Divide back: dividing the self-adjoint equation by e−x recovers xy″+(1−x)y′+ay=0.

  • 正性：在 x>0 上，p(x)=xe−x>0 且 w(x)=e−x>0。

    Positivity: on x>0, p(x)=xe−x>0 and w(x)=e−x>0.

学完试一题：合上例题，自己做Try it yourself: close the worked example＋

先独立写第一步。卡住时只开一个提示，做完再核对答案。Write your first step independently. Open one hint if stuck; check the solution after attempting the problem.

考虑非零本征函数 X∈C2([0,1]) 满足 −X″=λX。端点采用外法线 Robin 条件 −X′(0)+X(0)=0、X′(1)+X(1)=0。用分部积分证明所有本征值为实数且严格为正，特别说明零本征值为什么不可能。可允许 X 和 λ 先取复数。

Let a nonzero eigenfunction X∈C2([0,1]) satisfy −X″=λX, with outward-normal Robin conditions −X′(0)+X(0)=0 and X′(1)+X(1)=0. Use integration by parts to prove that every eigenvalue is real and strictly positive, explaining in particular why zero is impossible. Allow X and λ initially to be complex.

提示 1：先选方法Hint 1: choose a method＋

将方程乘 X― 后在区间积分，保留边界项。

Multiply the equation by X― and integrate over the interval, keeping the boundary term.

提示 2：写第一行Hint 2: write the first line＋

分部积分给 λ∫01|X|2dx=∫01|X′|2dx−[X―X′]01。

Integration by parts gives λ∫01|X|2dx=∫01|X′|2dx−[X―X′]01.

提示 3：关键计算Hint 3: key calculation＋

两端分别有 X′(0)=X(0)、X′(1)=−X(1)，所以边界贡献是两个正的端点平方。

The endpoints give X′(0)=X(0) and X′(1)=−X(1), so the boundary contribution is the sum of two nonnegative endpoint squares.

展开分步完整解答Open the full step-by-step solution＋

区间左端的外法线方向向左，右端向右。

因此同样的正系数 Robin 条件在两端写成 −X′(0)+X(0)=0 和 X′(1)+X(1)=0；不能把两端导数符号写成相同。

将方程乘 X― 并积分，得到 λ∫01|X|2dx=∫01|X′|2dx−[X―X′]01。

用 X′(0)=X(0)、X′(1)=−X(1)，右边化为 ∫01|X′|2dx+|X(0)|2+|X(1)|2。

非零连续函数满足 ∫01|X|2dx>0。

所以 λ=∫01|X′|2dx+|X(0)|2+|X(1)|2∫01|X|2dx 是实数且非负。

若 λ=0，分子每一项都必须为零，故 X′=0 且 X(0)=0。

前者使函数为常数，后者使常数为零，与本征函数非零矛盾。

因此所有本征值实际上满足 λ>0。

The outward normal points left at the left endpoint and right at the right endpoint.

Thus Robin conditions with the same positive coefficient become −X′(0)+X(0)=0 and X′(1)+X(1)=0.

Their derivative signs must not be written identically.

Multiply by X― and integrate to obtain λ∫01|X|2dx=∫01|X′|2dx−[X―X′]01.

With X′(0)=X(0) and X′(1)=−X(1), the right side becomes ∫01|X′|2dx+|X(0)|2+|X(1)|2.

A nonzero continuous function has ∫01|X|2dx>0.

Therefore λ=∫01|X′|2dx+|X(0)|2+|X(1)|2∫01|X|2dx is real and nonnegative.

If λ=0, every numerator term must vanish, giving X′=0 and X(0)=0.

The first makes the function constant and the second makes that constant zero, contradicting a nonzero eigenfunction.

Thus every eigenvalue actually satisfies λ>0.

怎样检查，哪里容易错Check your result and common mistakes＋

单独令 λ=0，写出 X=ax+b 并代入两端，可再次得到 a=b=0。典型错误是只看微分方程就宣称非负，而没有检查 Robin 边界项的符号。

As a second check, set λ=0, write X=ax+b, and apply both endpoint conditions to obtain a=b=0. A common error is to claim nonnegativity from the differential equation without examining the signs of the Robin boundary terms.

习题 3.1 · 1Exercise 3.1 · 1教材 p.134 / PDF p.143Textbook p.134 / PDF p.143

四分之一点拉弦后释放Pluck and release a string at its quarter point

长 l、线密度 ρ、张力 T 的均匀弦，两端 x=0,l 固定。在 x=l/4 用微小横向力 F（F≪T）拉至静止后放手。(1)建立完整定解问题；(2)用分离变量法求振动。

A uniform string has length l, linear density ρ, tension T, and fixed ends x=0,l. A small transverse force F (F≪T) pulls it at x=l/4 until it is at rest, then is released. (1) Formulate the complete problem. (2) Solve by separation of variables.

这道题到底要什么What must you find?

从“拉一下再放手”写出整根弦之后怎样运动。

Find the motion of a string that is pulled aside and then released.

凭什么选这个方法Why this method?

先区分拉弦和放手两个阶段。拉弦决定初始形状；放手后没有持续外力。

Separate the pulling stage from the free-motion stage. Pulling sets the initial shape; there is no sustained force after release.

基础运算卡住时，先补这一项：If the basic calculation is unfamiliar, practice: 边界与本征值Boundaries and eigenvalues · 正交投影Orthogonal projection

零基础逐步讲解：一次只做一步Beginner walkthrough: one step at a time＋

先不要抄最终答案。看完当前一步，在纸上写完，再点“下一步”。Do not copy the final answer. Complete the current step on paper before choosing Next step.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    令 u(x,t) 为横向位移，c=T/ρ 为波速；放手后微段受力给 ρutt=Tuxx。

    F 只决定放手时的形状。

    Let u(x,t) be transverse displacement and c=T/ρ the wave speed.

    After release, force balance gives ρutt=Tuxx.

    The earlier force F only sets the initial shape.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    把拉点记为 a=l/4，高度记为 h。

    Write the pulling point as a=l/4 and its height as h.

    两侧斜率大小为 h/a 与 h/(l−a)，故 T[h/a+h/(l−a)]=F，算得 h=3Fl/(16T)。

    The two slope magnitudes are h/a and h/(l−a), so T[h/a+h/(l−a)]=F gives h=3Fl/(16T).

  3. 第 3 步Step 3
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    用两条直线写初形：φ=3Fx/(4T)（x≤l/4），φ=F(l−x)/(4T)（x≥l/4）；再写 u(0,t)=u(l,t)=0 和 ut(x,0)=0，这就完成第(1)问。

    Write the two straight pieces: φ=3Fx/(4T) for x≤l/4 and φ=F(l−x)/(4T) for x≥l/4.

    Add u(0,t)=u(l,t)=0 and ut(x,0)=0 to complete part (1).

  4. 第 4 步Step 4
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    第(2)问先选 Xn=sin(knx)，kn=nπ/l（n≥1），因为它在两个端点都为零。

    For part (2), choose Xn=sin(knx) with kn=nπ/l for n≥1, since both endpoint values vanish.

    每个空间模态对应时间方程 qn′′+c2kn2qn=0。

    Its time coefficient satisfies qn′′+c2kn2qn=0.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    把投影积分在拉点拆开：An=2l[∫0l/43Fx4Tsinknxdx+∫l/4lF(l−x)4Tsinknxdx]。

    Split the projection at the pulling point: An=2l[∫0l/43Fx4Tsinknxdx+∫l/4lF(l−x)4Tsinknxdx].

    用 ∫xsinkxdx=−xcoskx/k+sinkx/k2 得 An=2FlTn2π2sinnπ4。

    Using ∫xsinkxdx=−xcoskx/k+sinkx/k2 gives An=2FlTn2π2sinnπ4.

  6. 第 6 步Step 6
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    零初速度去掉时间正弦项，得到 u=∑n≥1Ansin(knx)cos(cknt)。

    Zero initial velocity removes the sine term in time, leaving u=∑n≥1Ansin(knx)cos(cknt).

    检查 t=0 恢复两段直线，且每项在 x=0,l 为零。

    At t=0 the series recovers the two straight pieces, and each term vanishes at x=0,l.

做完先别看答案，自己检查Check your work before opening the answer

放手后方程右边还保留 F 吗？

Does F remain on the right side of the equation after release?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

不保留。F 只用于确定放手时的初始形状。

No. It is used only to determine the initial shape.

只看起手提示Show only a starting hint＋

拉点位移 h=3Fl/(16T)；也可用 −Tφ″=Fδ(x−l/4) 快速求系数。

The displacement at the plucking point is h=3Fl/(16T). Alternatively, −Tφ″=Fδ(x−l/4) quickly gives the coefficients.

参考完整解答：先看分步讲解再打开Full reference solution: use after the guided steps＋
整道题的路线Plan for the whole problem

先由静力平衡得到三角形初位移，再展开到两端固定的正弦模态。

First find the triangular initial displacement from static equilibrium, then expand it in the sine modes for two fixed ends.

把计算一行一行写出来Write the calculation line by line

  1. 小段弦的横向力差为 Tuxxdx，质量为 ρdx，故 utt=c2uxx，c2=T/ρ。

  2. 静态弦在拉点两侧是直线。

令 a=l/4、拉点高度 h，力平衡 T[h/a+h/(l−a)]=F，得 h=3Fl/(16T)。

初位移为 φ(x)=3Fx/(4T)（0≤x≤l/4）、F(l−x)/(4T)（l/4≤x≤l）；初速度零。

  1. 完整条件为 u(0,t)=u(l,t)=0，u(x,0)=φ(x)，ut(x,0)=0。

  2. 取 Xn=sinknx，kn=nπ/l。

由静态折点方程或分段积分得

An=2l∫0lφ(x)sinknxdx=2FlTn2π2sinnπ4.
因此
u(x,t)=2FlTπ2∑n=1∞sin(nπ/4)n2sinnπxlcoscnπtl.
张力和线密度单位分别为 N、kg/m，c 的单位确为 m/s。

1.

The difference of transverse tension forces on a segment is Tuxxdx, and its mass is ρdx.

Thus utt=c2uxx, with c2=T/ρ. 2.

The static string is straight on each side of the pull.

With a=l/4 and height h, force balance gives T[h/a+h/(l−a)]=F, hence h=3Fl/(16T).

The initial displacement is φ(x)=3Fx/(4T) for 0≤x≤l/4 and F(l−x)/(4T) for l/4≤x≤l.

Initial velocity is zero. 3.

The complete conditions are u(0,t)=u(l,t)=0, u(x,0)=φ(x), and ut(x,0)=0. 4.

Choose Xn=sinknx with kn=nπ/l.

Using the static corner equation or piecewise integration gives

An=2l∫0lφ(x)sinknxdx=2FlTn2π2sinnπ4.
Therefore
u(x,t)=2FlTπ2∑n=1∞sin(nπ/4)n2sinnπxlcoscnπtl.
Tension has units N and linear density kg/m, so c indeed has units m/s.
最后答案Final answer

utt=(T/ρ)uxx，两端零位移、上述三角形初位移、初速度零；u=2FlTπ2∑n≥1sin(nπ/4)sin(nπx/l)cos(cnπt/l)/n2。

utt=(T/ρ)uxx, zero displacement at both ends, the triangular initial displacement above, and zero initial velocity. u=2FlTπ2∑n≥1sin(nπ/4)sin(nπx/l)cos(cnπt/l)/n2.

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

静态拉弦 → 斜率差平衡求三角初形 → 正弦投影 → 零初速只留时间余弦。

Static pull → slope-jump balance gives the triangular initial shape → sine projection → zero initial velocity retains only cosine-in-time terms.

易错点

Common mistakes

F 是拉弦前的力；放手后方程右端为零，不应继续加入持续外力。

F acts before release. After release the equation has zero forcing; do not keep a sustained force in it.

习题 3.1 · 2Exercise 3.1 · 2教材 p.134 / PDF p.143Textbook p.134 / PDF p.143

一端固定杆压缩后释放Release a compressed rod with one fixed end

均匀细杆长 l，截面积 S，质量密度 ρ，杨氏模量 Y。x=0 固定，从 x=l 压至长度 l(1−2e)，静止后放手。(1)建立纵振动定解问题；(2)分离变量求解。

A uniform slender rod has length l, cross-section S, mass density ρ, and Young’s modulus Y. The end x=0 is fixed. Compress it from x=l to length l(1−2e), bring it to rest, and release it. (1) Formulate its longitudinal-vibration problem. (2) Solve by separation.

这道题到底要什么What must you find?

求一端固定、另一端放开的压缩杆怎样回弹。

Find how a compressed rod rebounds when one end is fixed and the other is released.

凭什么选这个方法Why this method?

u 是相对未压缩杆的位移；压缩让位移为负。放开的端点不受力，所以给的是导数条件。

u measures displacement from the undeformed rod. Compression gives negative displacement. A released end has zero force, so its condition concerns the derivative.

基础运算卡住时，先补这一项：If the basic calculation is unfamiliar, practice: 边界与本征值Boundaries and eigenvalues · 正交投影Orthogonal projection

零基础逐步讲解：一次只做一步Beginner walkthrough: one step at a time＋

先不要抄最终答案。看完当前一步，在纸上写完，再点“下一步”。Do not copy the final answer. Complete the current step on paper before choosing Next step.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    以未压缩杆为参考定义纵位移 u。

    Measure longitudinal displacement u from the undeformed rod.

    杆长缩短 2el 表示均匀应变 ux=−2e；左端固定使积分常数为零，所以初位移为 -2ex。

    A shortening of 2el means uniform strain ux=−2e; the fixed left end sets the integration constant to zero, giving initial displacement -2ex.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    轴力是 N=YSux，微段质量为 ρSdx。

    The axial force is N=YSux, and a small segment has mass ρSdx.

    由 ρSutt=(YSux)x 得 utt=c2uxx，c=Y/ρ；截面积 S 在波速中约掉。

    Thus ρSutt=(YSux)x gives utt=c2uxx with c=Y/ρ; S cancels from the speed.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    第(1)问的条件为 u(0,t)=0、ux(l,t)=0、u(x,0)=-2ex、ut(x,0)=0。

    The conditions for part (1) are u(0,t)=0, ux(l,t)=0, u(x,0)=-2ex, and ut(x,0)=0.

    右端自由表示零轴力，不能写成右端位移为零。

    A free right end means zero axial force, rather than zero displacement.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    第(2)问由 X(0)=0 取 X=sinkx；再由 X′(l)=kcoskl=0 得 kn=(n+1/2)π/l，n=0,1,…。

    For part (2), X(0)=0 selects X=sinkx.

    The condition X′(l)=kcoskl=0 then gives kn=(n+1/2)π/l for n=0,1,….

  5. 第 5 步Step 5
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    范数为 ∫0lsin2(knx)dx=l/2，所以 An=−4el∫0lxsin(knx)dx。

    The squared norm is ∫0lsin2(knx)dx=l/2, so An=−4el∫0lxsin(knx)dx.

    用 cosknl=0、sinknl=(−1)n 得 An=−4e(−1)n/(lkn2)。

    With cosknl=0 and sinknl=(−1)n, this becomes An=−4e(−1)n/(lkn2).

  6. 第 6 步Step 6
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    零初速度给 u=∑n≥0Ansin(knx)cos(cknt)。

    Zero initial velocity gives u=∑n≥0Ansin(knx)cos(cknt).

    释放前的端点应变不是零，与释放后的边界在 t=0 瞬间不相容；初形按内部极限或能量解恢复，不强求角点逐项求导。

    The pre-release endpoint strain is nonzero and conflicts with the new boundary at t=0; recover the initial shape by interior limits or an energy solution, without termwise differentiation at that corner.

右端自由应写 u(l,t)=0 吗？

Does a free right end mean u(l,t)=0?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

不是。自由是零应力，线性杆中写 uₓ(l,t)=0。

No. It means zero stress, written uₓ(l,t)=0 for a linear rod.

只看起手提示Show only a starting hint＋

初始均匀压缩给 u(x,0)=-2ex；固定—自由基为半整数正弦。

Uniform initial compression gives u(x,0)=-2ex. The fixed–free basis consists of half-integer sine modes.

参考完整解答：先看分步讲解再打开Full reference solution: use after the guided steps＋
整道题的路线Plan for the whole problem

位移相对未变形杆定义；固定端位移零，释放端应力零。

Measure displacement from the undeformed rod. The fixed end has zero displacement; the released end has zero stress.

把计算一行一行写出来Write the calculation line by line

  1. 轴力 N=YSux，力平衡 ρSutt=(YSux)x，故 utt=c2uxx，c=Y/ρ。

  2. 放手后条件为 u(0,t)=0,ux(l,t)=0；均匀应变 −2e 给 u(x,0)=-2ex,ut(x,0)=0。

  3. 本征函数 sinknx，kn=(n+1/2)π/l，n=0,1,…。

范数 l/2，投影

An=−4el∫0lxsinknxdx=−4e(−1)nlkn2.
4. 得
u(x,t)=−4el∑n=0∞(−1)nkn2sinknxcos(cknt).
初始应变在自由端并非零，反映“撤去手力”的瞬间不相容；解按能量/内部极限理解，释放后应力条件对 t>0 成立。

1.

The axial force is N=YSux.

Force balance gives ρSutt=(YSux)x, so utt=c2uxx and c=Y/ρ. 2.

After release, u(0,t)=0,ux(l,t)=0.

The uniform strain −2e gives u(x,0)=-2ex,ut(x,0)=0. 3.

The eigenfunctions are sinknx, where kn=(n+1/2)π/l, n=0,1,….

Their squared norm is l/2, so

An=−4el∫0lxsinknxdx=−4e(−1)nlkn2.
4.

Thus

u(x,t)=−4el∑n=0∞(−1)nkn2sinknxcos(cknt).
The initial strain is not zero at the free end: this reflects the instantaneous removal of the applied force.

Interpret the solution in an energy sense or by interior limits.

The released-end stress condition holds for t>0.

最后答案Final answer

utt=(Y/ρ)uxx；u(0,t)=0,ux(l,t)=0；初位移 -2ex、初速度零；上述半整数正弦级数。

utt=(Y/ρ)uxx; u(0,t)=0,ux(l,t)=0; initial displacement -2ex, zero initial velocity, and the half-integer sine series above.

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

杆纵振动 → 杨氏应力 → 固定端/自由端区分 → 半整数频率 → 初始应变投影。

Longitudinal rod vibration → Young’s stress → distinguish fixed and free ends → half-integer frequencies → project the initial deformation.

易错点

Common mistakes

释放后的右端是零应力，不是零位移；截面积在波速中约掉。

The released end has zero stress, not zero displacement. Cross-sectional area cancels from the wave speed.

两端自由杆压缩释放Release a compressed rod with both ends free

均匀细杆长 l，截面积 S，密度 ρ，杨氏模量 Y。从两端施压使长度变为 l(1−2e)，静止后同时放手。(1)建立定解问题；(2)用分离变量法求解。

A uniform slender rod has length l, cross-section S, density ρ, and Young’s modulus Y. Compress it from both ends to length l(1−2e), bring it to rest, and release both ends simultaneously. (1) Formulate the problem. (2) Solve by separation of variables.

这道题到底要什么What must you find?

求两端自由的压缩杆回弹，同时不漏掉整体平移。

Find the recoil of a rod free at both ends without losing rigid translation.

凭什么选这个方法Why this method?

两端都没有力，空间模式用余弦；余弦族里包含常数模式，代表整根杆一起移动。

Both ends have zero force, giving cosine modes. The cosine family includes a constant mode, representing movement of the whole rod.

零基础逐步讲解：一次只做一步Beginner walkthrough: one step at a time＋

先不要抄最终答案。看完当前一步，在纸上写完，再点“下一步”。Do not copy the final answer. Complete the current step on paper before choosing Next step.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    先固定参考位置：取杆中心不动，则均匀压缩的初位移是 φ(x)=e(l−2x)。

    First choose a reference position with the rod center fixed.

    检查 φ(l)−φ(0)=−2el，确实使杆长缩短 2el。

    Uniform compression then gives φ(x)=e(l−2x); the difference φ(l)−φ(0)=−2el confirms the required shortening.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    第(1)问写 utt=c2uxx，c=Y/ρ；两端都释放，所以 ux(0,t)=ux(l,t)=0，初速度为零。

    For part (1), write utt=c2uxx with c=Y/ρ.

    Both ends are released, so ux(0,t)=ux(l,t)=0, and the initial velocity is zero.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    第(2)问用余弦基 Xn=cos(nπx/l)，并保留常数基 X0=1。

    For part (2), use Xn=cos(nπx/l) and retain the constant mode X0=1.

    常数模态描述整根杆平移；本题初位移的平均值为零，因此该模态系数为零。

    That mode represents rigid translation; its coefficient vanishes here because the initial displacement has zero average.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    对 n≥1 计算 An=2l∫0le(l−2x)cos(nπx/l)dx。

    For n≥1, calculate An=2l∫0le(l−2x)cos(nπx/l)dx.

    常数部分积分为零，∫0lxcos(knx)dx=[(−1)n−1]/kn2，故 An=4el[1−(−1)n]/(n2π2)。

    The constant part integrates to zero, while ∫0lxcos(knx)dx=[(−1)n−1]/kn2, giving An=4el[1−(−1)n]/(n2π2).

  5. 第 5 步Step 5
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    偶数 n 的系数为零；令 n=2m+1，把 A2m+1=8el/[(2m+1)2π2] 乘上 cos[(2m+1)πx/l]cos[c(2m+1)πt/l] 后求和。

    Even n have zero coefficient.

    Set n=2m+1, then sum A2m+1=8el/[(2m+1)2π2] times cos[(2m+1)πx/l]cos[c(2m+1)πt/l].

  6. 第 6 步Step 6
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    若只给最终长度而没固定中心，可在解上加常数 C；它不改变应变和振动。

    If only the final length is prescribed, an arbitrary constant C may be added to the solution; it changes neither strain nor vibration.

    释放瞬间的端点应变不相容按能量解理解，不能由角点不相容断言没有解。

    Interpret the incompatible endpoint strain at release in the energy-solution sense.

为什么不能直接从 n=1 开始而不提常数模式？

Why mention the constant mode instead of silently starting at n=1?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

因为自由—自由边界允许零频整体平移；本题靠初始平均位移为 0 才排除它。

Free–free boundaries admit zero-frequency rigid translation. Only the zero initial mean excludes it here.

只看起手提示Show only a starting hint＋

取 u(x,0)=e(l−2x)，余弦投影只有奇数模态。

Take u(x,0)=e(l−2x). Its cosine expansion contains only odd modes.

参考完整解答：先看分步讲解再打开Full reference solution: use after the guided steps＋
整道题的路线Plan for the whole problem

两端释放后均为零应力；以杆中心不动的对称压缩选择初位移，常数模态代表刚体平移。

Both released ends have zero stress. Choose symmetric compression with the center fixed to specify the initial displacement. The constant mode represents rigid translation.

把计算一行一行写出来Write the calculation line by line

均匀杆满足 utt=c2uxx，c=Y/ρ，边界为 ux(0,t)=ux(l,t)=0。

对称压缩、中心不动时，u(x,0)=e(l−2x)、ut(x,0)=0。

长度差确为 u(l,0)−u(0,0)=−2el。

Neumann基含常数和 cos(nπx/l)。

初位移平均为零，常数模态不激发。

对 n≥1，

An=2l∫0le(l−2x)cosnπxldx=4el[1−(−1)n]n2π2.
于是
u=8elπ2∑m=0∞cos[(2m+1)πx/l]cos[c(2m+1)πt/l](2m+1)2.
若题给压缩过程不保证中心位置，只给最终长度，则还允许在初位移和解上加任意常数 C；这仅改变刚体平移，变形与振动不变。

初始端点应变与释放条件的瞬时不相容按能量解处理。

The uniform rod satisfies utt=c2uxx with c=Y/ρ and ux(0,t)=ux(l,t)=0.

For symmetric compression with the center unmoved, u(x,0)=e(l−2x) and ut(x,0)=0.

The length change is indeed u(l,0)−u(0,0)=−2el.

The Neumann basis contains a constant and cos(nπx/l).

The initial displacement has zero mean, so the constant mode is not excited.

For n≥1,

An=2l∫0le(l−2x)cosnπxldx=4el[1−(−1)n]n2π2.
Thus
u=8elπ2∑m=0∞cos[(2m+1)πx/l]cos[c(2m+1)πt/l](2m+1)2.
If the compression process specifies only the final length, rather than the center position, an arbitrary constant C may be added to the initial displacement and the solution.

This changes only rigid translation, not deformation or vibration.

Treat the instantaneous mismatch between initial endpoint strain and the released-end condition in the energy-solution sense.

最后答案Final answer

两端 ux=0，初位移 e(l−2x)（中心固定约定），初速度零；u=8elπ2∑m≥0cos[(2m+1)πx/l]cos[c(2m+1)πt/l]/(2m+1)2，可加任意常数平移。

Both ends have ux=0. With the fixed-center convention, the initial displacement is e(l−2x) and velocity zero. u=8elπ2∑m≥0cos[(2m+1)πx/l]cos[c(2m+1)πt/l]/(2m+1)2, up to an arbitrary constant translation.

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

自由—自由杆 → 余弦含零模态 → 先固定中心/平均值 → 投影得对称模态。

Free–free rod → cosine basis including a zero mode → fix the center or mean first → project to find the symmetry-selected modes.

易错点

Common mistakes

只给压缩长度不能决定整体平移；不要遗漏零频刚体模态。

The compressed length alone does not determine rigid translation. Do not omit the zero-frequency rigid mode.
