固定—绝热杆的热衰减（原书重复题）Heat decay in a rod with one fixed-temperature and one insulated end (duplicate in the textbook)

长 l 的均匀细杆侧面绝热，x=0 端保持零温，x=l 端绝热，初温为 x(l−x)。(1)给出完整定解问题；(2)分离变量求温度随时间变化。

A uniform slender rod of length l has an insulated lateral surface. Its end x=0 is held at zero temperature and its end x=l is insulated. Initial temperature is x(l−x). (1) Give the complete problem. (2) Find the time-dependent temperature by separation.

读题注意Read this first

此题与教材同节题 4 重复，保留原题号；本征展开与初边值相容性同题 4。

This repeats question 4 in the same section. The original number is retained; the eigenfunction expansion and compatibility discussion are the same.

这道题到底要什么What must you find?

用混合边界算细杆的降温；确认这就是上一题的原书重复题。

Find heat decay with mixed boundaries; this is the textbook duplicate of the preceding question.

凭什么选这个方法Why this method?

左端零温控制值，右端绝热控制导数；这种组合选半整数正弦。

The left end prescribes temperature and the right prescribes its derivative. This combination selects half-integer sine modes.

基础运算卡住时，先补这一项：If the basic calculation is unfamiliar, practice: 边界与本征值Boundaries and eigenvalues · 正交投影Orthogonal projection

零基础逐步讲解：一次只做一步Beginner walkthrough: one step at a time＋

先不要抄最终答案。看完当前一步，在纸上写完，再点“下一步”。Do not copy the final answer. Complete the current step on paper before choosing Next step.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    第(1)问写 ut=κuxx，κ=k/(ρc)>0；零温端给 u(0,t)=0，绝热端给 ux(l,t)=0，初温为 x(l−x)。

    For part (1), write ut=κuxx with κ=k/(ρc)>0, boundaries u(0,t)=0 and ux(l,t)=0, and initial temperature x(l−x).

    原书第4、5题题面相同，解也应相同。

    Textbook questions 4 and 5 are identical and have the same solution.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    第(2)问令 u=X(x)T(t)。

    For part (2), set u=X(x)T(t).

    X(0)=0 选正弦，再由 X′(l)=0 得 kn=(n+1/2)π/l，空间基为 sin(knx)，n≥0。

    The condition X(0)=0 selects sine, and X′(l)=0 gives kn=(n+1/2)π/l, so the basis is sin(knx) for n≥0.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    时间方程是 T′=−κkn2T，所以每项乘 e−κkn2t；负号表示热扩散削弱温度差。

    The time equation is T′=−κkn2T, giving factor e−κkn2t for each mode.

    The negative sign represents decay of temperature differences.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    初温投影 An=2l∫0lf(x)sin(knx)dx，f=x(l−x)。

    Project the initial temperature using An=2l∫0lf(x)sin(knx)dx, where f=x(l−x).

    第一次分部积分的端点项为零，因为 f(0)=f(l)=0。

    The first integration by parts has zero endpoint term because f(0)=f(l)=0.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    第二次分部积分用 f′(l)=−l、f″=−2：积分等于 −l(−1)n/kn2+2/kn3，故 An=4/(lkn3)−2(−1)n/kn2。

    A second integration by parts uses f′(l)=−l and f″=−2, giving integral −l(−1)n/kn2+2/kn3.

    Thus An=4/(lkn3)−2(−1)n/kn2.

  6. 第 6 步Step 6
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    合成 u=∑n≥0Ansin(knx)e−κkn2t。

    初温导数在右端不是零，初值按内部或 L2 极限恢复；t>0 时绝热条件成立，长期所有模态衰减到零。

    Assemble u=∑n≥0Ansin(knx)e−κkn2t.

    The initial right-end derivative is nonzero, so recover initial data by interior or L2 limits.

    The insulated condition holds for t>0, and all modes decay to zero eventually.

做完先别看答案，自己检查Check your work before opening the answer

n=0 的波数为 0 吗？

Is the n=0 wavenumber zero?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

不是。它是 π/(2l)；因此本题所有模式都会衰减。

No. It is π/(2l), so every mode in this problem decays.

只看起手提示Show only a starting hint＋

空间本征频率是 (n+1/2)π/l，投影多项式时保留两个分部积分项。

The spatial wavenumbers are (n+1/2)π/l. Keep both integration-by-parts contributions when projecting the polynomial.

整道题的路线Plan for the whole problem

固定零温与绝热构成混合边界，选半整数正弦；原书第4、5题题干完全相同，应给相同解。

Zero temperature at one end and insulation at the other give mixed boundaries and half-integer sine modes. Textbook questions 4 and 5 are identical, so their solutions must agree.

把计算一行一行写出来Write the calculation line by line

设热扩散率 κ=k/(ρc)>0，完整问题为 ut=κuxx（0<x<l,t>0）、u(0,t)=0,ux(l,t)=0、u(x,0)=x(l−x)。

分离给 Xn=sinknx、kn=(n+1/2)π/l，时间因子 e−κkn2t。

范数 l/2，两次分部积分得到

An=2l∫0lx(l−x)sinknxdx=4lkn3−2(−1)nkn2.
因此
u(x,t)=∑n=0∞[4lkn3−2(−1)nkn2]sinknxe−κkn2t.
初温在右端的导数为 −l，与绝热条件的角点不相容；热方程对 t>0 平滑，初值按内部/L2极限恢复即可。

长时间全部模态衰减到零，因为左端始终保持零温。

Let κ=k/(ρc)>0.

The full problem is ut=κuxx for 0<x<l,t>0, u(0,t)=0,ux(l,t)=0, and u(x,0)=x(l−x).

Separation gives Xn=sinknx, kn=(n+1/2)π/l, and time factor e−κkn2t.

The squared norm is l/2.

Integrating by parts twice gives

An=2l∫0lx(l−x)sinknxdx=4lkn3−2(−1)nkn2.
Therefore
u(x,t)=∑n=0∞[4lkn3−2(−1)nkn2]sinknxe−κkn2t.
The initial temperature has derivative −l at the right end, so the initial data and insulated boundary are incompatible at that corner.

The heat equation smooths for t>0; recover the initial data by interior or L² limits.

All modes eventually decay to zero because the left end remains at zero temperature.

最后答案Final answer

ut=κuxx，u(0,t)=0,ux(l,t)=0，初温 x(l−x)；u=∑n≥0[4/(lkn3)−2(−1)n/kn2]sinknxe−κkn2t，kn=(n+1/2)π/l。

ut=κuxx, u(0,t)=0,ux(l,t)=0, and initial temperature x(l−x). u=∑n≥0[4/(lkn3)−2(−1)n/kn2]sinknxe−κkn2t with kn=(n+1/2)π/l.

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

混合热边界 → 半整数正弦 → 初温投影 → 每模态乘扩散衰减指数。

Mixed thermal boundaries → half-integer sine modes → project the initial temperature → multiply each mode by its diffusion decay factor.

易错点

Common mistakes

右端绝热是 ux(l,t)=0，不是 u(l,t)=0；教材第5题是第4题的重复，不能另造题干。

Insulation means ux(l,t)=0, not u(l,t)=0. Textbook question 5 repeats question 4; do not invent a different question.

习题 3.2 · 6Exercise 3.2 · 6教材 p.150 / PDF p.159Textbook p.150 / PDF p.159

已给模态的两端零温杆A zero-end-temperature rod with its modes already given

长 l 的均匀杆侧面绝热，两端保持零温。初温 3sin(πx/l)+2sin(3πx/l)。(1)定解问题；(2)分离变量求解。

A uniform rod of length l has an insulated lateral surface and both ends held at zero temperature. Its initial temperature is 3sin(πx/l)+2sin(3πx/l). (1) Formulate the problem. (2) Solve by separation.

这道题到底要什么What must you find?

直接读出已给模式的温度解，避免不必要的积分。

Read the temperature solution directly from the given modes.

凭什么选这个方法Why this method?

初温已经是固定端的正弦模式；保留原来的 3、2 系数，分别加各自的衰减。

The initial data already use the fixed-end sine modes. Keep coefficients 3 and 2 and attach each mode’s decay factor.

基础运算卡住时，先补这一项：If the basic calculation is unfamiliar, practice: 边界与本征值Boundaries and eigenvalues · 正交投影Orthogonal projection

零基础逐步讲解：一次只做一步Beginner walkthrough: one step at a time＋

先不要抄最终答案。看完当前一步，在纸上写完，再点“下一步”。Do not copy the final answer. Complete the current step on paper before choosing Next step.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    第(1)问写 ut=κuxx、u(0,t)=u(l,t)=0，初温为 3sin(πx/l)+2sin(3πx/l)；κ=k/(ρc)。

    For part (1), write ut=κuxx, u(0,t)=u(l,t)=0, and initial temperature 3sin(πx/l)+2sin(3πx/l), with κ=k/(ρc).

  2. 第 2 步Step 2
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    两端零温的基为 sin(nπx/l)。

    The zero-temperature basis is sin(nπx/l).

    初温已经按这个基展开，所以第(2)问直接读出 a1=3、a3=2，其他系数为零，无需再积分。

    Since the initial data are already expanded in it, part (2) has a1=3 and a3=2, with all others zero; no projection integral is needed.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    第一模态满足 q1′=−κ(π/l)2q1、q1(0)=3，所以 q1=3e−κπ2t/l2。

    The first mode satisfies q1′=−κ(π/l)2q1 and q1(0)=3, giving q1=3e−κπ2t/l2.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    第三模态满足 q3′=−κ(3π/l)2q3、q3(0)=2，所以 q3=2e−9κπ2t/l2；指数中的倍数来自频率平方。

    The third mode satisfies q3′=−κ(3π/l)2q3 and q3(0)=2, giving q3=2e−9κπ2t/l2.

    The factor 9 comes from squaring the spatial frequency.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    合成 u=q1sin(πx/l)+q3sin(3πx/l)。

    Combine u=q1sin(πx/l)+q3sin(3πx/l).

    检查 t=0 恢复初温，两端恒为零；第三模态先衰减，长期由第一模态主导。

    At t=0 it recovers the data and both ends remain zero; the third mode decays faster, leaving the first dominant at long times.

做完先别看答案，自己检查Check your work before opening the answer

哪个模式衰减更快，快在指数的几倍？

Which mode decays faster, and by what rate factor?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

第三模式更快，其衰减率是第一模式的 9 倍。

The third mode decays faster, with nine times the first mode’s decay rate.

只看起手提示Show only a starting hint＋

第一、第三模态的衰减率之比为 1:9。

The decay rates of the first and third modes are in ratio 1:9.

参考完整解答：先看分步讲解再打开Full reference solution: use after the guided steps＋
整道题的路线Plan for the whole problem

初温已经是两个本征模态，无需再积分。

The initial temperature is already a sum of two eigenmodes, so no projection integrals are needed.

把计算一行一行写出来Write the calculation line by line

完整问题 ut=κuxx，u(0,t)=u(l,t)=0，初温如题，κ=k/(ρc)。

固定两端的模态 sin(nπx/l) 随时间乘 e−κn2π2t/l2，因此

u(x,t)=3e−κπ2t/l2sinπxl+2e−9κπ2t/l2sin3πxl.
t=0 还原初温，两个端点始终零；直接求导可检验每项均满足热方程。

第三模态衰减快，长期由第一模态主导。

The complete problem is ut=κuxx, u(0,t)=u(l,t)=0, with the given initial temperature and κ=k/(ρc).

Each fixed-end mode sin(nπx/l) gains time factor e−κn2π2t/l2.

Thus

u(x,t)=3e−κπ2t/l2sinπxl+2e−9κπ2t/l2sin3πxl.
At t=0 this recovers the initial temperature, and both endpoint values stay zero.

Differentiation verifies the heat equation term by term.

The third mode decays faster, so the first dominates at long times.

最后答案Final answer

u=3e−κπ2t/l2sin(πx/l)+2e−9κπ2t/l2sin(3πx/l)。

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

初温已是本征函数和 → 原系数不变 → 逐模态写指数衰减。

Initial temperature already given as eigenfunctions → keep their coefficients → attach the appropriate decay factor to each mode.

易错点

Common mistakes

第三模态的指数是 9 倍，不是 3 倍。

The third mode’s exponent is multiplied by 9, not 3.

习题 3.2 · 7Exercise 3.2 · 7教材 p.150 / PDF p.159Textbook p.150 / PDF p.159

温度正反馈与临界杆长Positive temperature feedback and a critical rod length

长 l 的均匀细杆侧面绝热，两端温度零。内部单位长度、单位时间产热与当地温度成正比，比例系数 β>0，初温 φ(x)。(1)求温度；(2)求杆长超过后会发生温度增长的临界长度。

A uniform slender rod of length l has an insulated lateral surface and zero temperature at both ends. Heat generated per unit length per unit time is proportional to the local temperature, with coefficient β>0. Initial temperature is φ(x). (1) Find the temperature. (2) Find the critical length above which temperature growth is possible.

这道题到底要什么What must you find?

判断产热反馈能否战胜散热，找到临界长度。

Decide whether heat-generation feedback overcomes diffusion and find the critical length.

凭什么选这个方法Why this method?

温度越高产热越多，这是正反馈；每个模式的“产热增长率−扩散衰减率”决定它增大还是减小。

Hotter material generates more heat. Each mode grows or decays according to generation rate minus diffusion decay rate.

基础运算卡住时，先补这一项：If the basic calculation is unfamiliar, practice: 边界与本征值Boundaries and eigenvalues · 正交投影Orthogonal projection

零基础逐步讲解：一次只做一步Beginner walkthrough: one step at a time＋

先不要抄最终答案。看完当前一步，在纸上写完，再点“下一步”。Do not copy the final answer. Complete the current step on paper before choosing Next step.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    题目的 βu 是单位长度产热率。

    The source βu is heat produced per unit length per unit time.

    先记单位长度热容 C=ρcS、导热参数 K=kS，写 Cut=Kuxx+βu，避免把有单位的 β 直接当增长率。

    Define heat capacity per unit length C=ρcS and conduction parameter K=kS, then write Cut=Kuxx+βu rather than treating β itself as a growth rate.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    除以 C，令 κ=K/C、γ=β/C，得到 ut=κuxx+γu。

    Divide by C and set κ=K/C and γ=β/C, giving ut=κuxx+γu.

    两端零温，初温 φ(x)。

    Both endpoint temperatures are zero and the initial temperature is φ(x).

  3. 第 3 步Step 3
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    第(1)问将初温投影为 an=2l∫0lφ(x)sin(nπx/l)dx，写 u=∑qn(t)sin(nπx/l)。

    For part (1), project the initial data with an=2l∫0lφ(x)sin(nπx/l)dx, and write u=∑qn(t)sin(nπx/l).

  4. 第 4 步Step 4
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    代入方程得到 qn′=[γ−κ(nπ/l)2]qn，所以 qn=ane[γ−κ(nπ/l)2]t。

    Substitution gives qn′=[γ−κ(nπ/l)2]qn, so qn=ane[γ−κ(nπ/l)2]t.

    括号内就是该模态的净增长率。

    The bracket is that mode's net growth rate.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    第(2)问找最先增长的模态。

    For part (2), find the first mode that can grow.

    n=1 的扩散损失最小，令 γ−κ(π/lc)2=0，得 lc=πκ/γ=πkS/β。

    Mode n=1 has the smallest diffusion loss; solving γ−κ(π/lc)2=0 gives lc=πκ/γ=πkS/β.

  6. 第 6 步Step 6
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    比较 l 与 lc：短于临界时全衰减，等于临界时第一模态不变，长于临界时存在增长模态。

    Compare l with lc: below it all modes decay, at it the first is constant, and above it growing modes exist.

    实际增长还要求相应 an≠0；严格零初温仍给零解。

    Actual growth requires a nonzero coefficient in a growing mode; exactly zero initial data still give the zero solution.

做完先别看答案，自己检查Check your work before opening the answer

l=l_c 时第一模式会指数增大吗？

At l=l_c, does the first mode grow exponentially?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

不会。此时增长率为 0，第一模式保持原幅度。

No. Its growth rate is zero, so its amplitude stays constant.

只看起手提示Show only a starting hint＋

用单位长度热容 C=ρcS、导热参数 K=kS，令 γ=β/C、κ=K/C。

Let heat capacity per unit length be C=ρcS and conduction parameter K=kS. Set γ=β/C, κ=K/C.

参考完整解答：先看分步讲解再打开Full reference solution: use after the guided steps＋
整道题的路线Plan for the whole problem

热源与温度成正比，使模态扩散衰减率减少一个常数。临界条件由最小空间本征值决定。

A source proportional to temperature subtracts a constant from each diffusion decay rate. The smallest spatial eigenvalue determines the onset of growth.

把计算一行一行写出来Write the calculation line by line

单位长度热守恒为 Cut=Kuxx+βu，所以 ut=κuxx+γu，κ=K/C、γ=β/C。

两端零温，初温为 φ。

展开 φ=∑ansin(nπx/l)，an=(2/l)∫0lφsin(nπx/l)dx。

每模态满足 qn′=[γ−κ(nπ/l)2]qn，得

u=∑n=1∞ane[γ−κ(nπ/l)2]tsinnπxl.
第一模态增长率最先变正，故
lc=πκ/γ=πK/β=πkS/β.
l<lc 时全部衰减；l=lc 时第一模态保持不变；l>lc 时存在增长模态。

实际温度增长还要求初温在某增长模态上投影不为零；例如非零非负初温必有 a1>0。

零初值或恰与全部增长模态正交的初值是例外。

若课件直接把 β 定义为归一化方程 ut=κuxx+βu 的系数，则其对应写法是 lc=πκ/β。

Heat conservation per unit length is Cut=Kuxx+βu.

Thus ut=κuxx+γu, where κ=K/C and γ=β/C, with zero endpoint temperatures and initial data φ.

Expand φ=∑ansin(nπx/l), where an=(2/l)∫0lφsin(nπx/l)dx.

Each mode satisfies qn′=[γ−κ(nπ/l)2]qn, so

u=∑n=1∞ane[γ−κ(nπ/l)2]tsinnπxl.
The first mode’s growth rate becomes positive first.

Hence

lc=πκ/γ=πK/β=πkS/β.
For l<lc, all modes decay.

At l=lc, the first mode is constant in time.

For l>lc, growing modes exist.

Actual growth also requires the initial data to have a nonzero projection onto at least one growing mode.

For example, nonzero nonnegative initial temperature has a1>0.

Zero initial data, or data orthogonal to every growing mode, are exceptions.

If a course handout instead defines β as the already-normalized coefficient in ut=κuxx+βu, the corresponding notation is lc=πκ/β.

最后答案Final answer

u=∑ane[γ−κ(nπ/l)2]tsin(nπx/l)；lc=πκ/γ，γ=β/(ρcS)，等价于 πkS/β。

u=∑ane[γ−κ(nπ/l)2]tsin(nπx/l). The critical length is lc=πκ/γ, with γ=β/(ρcS), equivalently πkS/β.

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

温度反馈源 → 保留物理单位归一化 → 模态增长率 → 第一模态临界 → 检查是否被初值激发。

Temperature-feedback source → normalize while retaining physical units → find modal growth rates → locate the first-mode threshold → check whether initial data excite growth.

易错点

Common mistakes

不要混用单位长度产热系数与已除热容的系数；超过临界长度并不让严格零解自发变非零。

Do not mix heat-generation coefficients per unit length with coefficients already divided by heat capacity. A length above threshold does not make the exactly zero solution spontaneously become nonzero.

习题 3.2 · 8Exercise 3.2 · 8教材 p.151 / PDF p.160Textbook p.151 / PDF p.160

绝热正方形薄片An insulated square plate

边长 a 的均匀正方形薄片位于第一象限，一角在原点，四边绝热，初始温度分布 φ(x,y)。求任意时刻温度。

A uniform square plate of side a lies in the first quadrant with one corner at the origin. All four edges are insulated and its initial temperature is φ(x,y). Find the temperature at any time.

这道题到底要什么What must you find?

计算绝热薄片如何把温度逐渐均匀化。

Calculate how an insulated plate becomes uniform in temperature.

凭什么选这个方法Why this method?

绝热控制法向导数，两个方向都选余弦；常数模式就是不会流失的平均温度。

Insulation prescribes normal derivatives, so use cosines in both directions. The constant mode is the conserved mean temperature.

基础运算卡住时，先补这一项：If the basic calculation is unfamiliar, practice: 边界与本征值Boundaries and eigenvalues · 正交投影Orthogonal projection

零基础逐步讲解：一次只做一步Beginner walkthrough: one step at a time＋

先不要抄最终答案。看完当前一步，在纸上写完，再点“下一步”。Do not copy the final answer. Complete the current step on paper before choosing Next step.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    四边绝热表示法向导数为零：ux(0,y,t)=ux(a,y,t)=0、uy(x,0,t)=uy(x,a,t)=0；方程为 ut=κ(uxx+uyy)。

    Insulation means zero normal derivative: ux(0,y,t)=ux(a,y,t)=0 and uy(x,0,t)=uy(x,a,t)=0.

    The equation is ut=κ(uxx+uyy).

  2. 第 2 步Step 2
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    每个方向选余弦并保留零频：Smn=cos(mπx/a)cos(nπy/a)，m,n≥0。

    Use cosines in each direction and retain zero frequencies: Smn=cos(mπx/a)cos(nπy/a) for m,n≥0.

    m=0 或 n=0 表示该方向温度不变化，不能删去。

    A zero index means no variation in that direction and must not be omitted.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    常数基的范数为 a，非零余弦的范数为 a/2。

    The constant basis has squared norm a, while a nonzero cosine has norm a/2.

    令 η0=1、ηj=2（j>0），用 Cmn=ηmηna2∬φSmndxdy 统一写出投影。

    Define η0=1 and ηj=2 for j>0, then write Cmn=ηmηna2∬φSmndxdy.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    两个方向的本征值相加，所以第 (m,n) 模态随时间乘 e−κπ2(m2+n2)t/a2。

    The two spatial eigenvalues add, so mode (m,n) has time factor e−κπ2(m2+n2)t/a2.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    合成 u=∑m,n≥0Cmne−κπ2(m2+n2)t/a2Smn。

    Assemble u=∑m,n≥0Cmne−κπ2(m2+n2)t/a2Smn.

    用 t=0 检查初温，用余弦导数中的正弦检查四边通量为零。

    Set t=0 to check the initial data; sine factors in the cosine derivatives verify zero flux on all edges.

  6. 第 6 步Step 6
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    只有 (0,0) 模态不衰减，故长期温度为 C00=a−2∬φdxdy。

    Only mode (0,0) does not decay, so the final temperature is C00=a−2∬φdxdy, the initial average.

    它是初始平均温度，与全绝热时总热量守恒相符。

    This agrees with heat conservation under complete insulation.

做完先别看答案，自己检查Check your work before opening the answer

长期温度一定是 0 吗？

Must the long-time temperature be zero?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

不是。它趋于初始平均温度 C₀₀，因为四边绝热不漏热。

No. It tends to the initial mean C₀₀ because the insulated edges do not leak heat.

只看起手提示Show only a starting hint＋

令 η0=1、ηn=2（n≥1），系数统一写 ηmηn/a2。

Set η0=1, ηn=2 for n≥1. Then the coefficient factor is uniformly ηmηn/a2.

参考完整解答：先看分步讲解再打开Full reference solution: use after the guided steps＋
整道题的路线Plan for the whole problem

绝热边界给双重余弦基，必须保留 (0,0) 平均温度模态。

Insulation gives a double-cosine basis. Retain the (0,0) mode, which carries the mean temperature.

把计算一行一行写出来Write the calculation line by line

  1. 第 1 步Step 1

    方程 ut=κ(uxx+uyy)，边界 ux(0,y,t)=ux(a,y,t)=0，uy(x,0,t)=uy(x,a,t)=0。

    The equation is ut=κ(uxx+uyy), with ux(0,y,t)=ux(a,y,t)=0 and uy(x,0,t)=uy(x,a,t)=0.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2

    令

    Define

    Cmn=ηmηna2∫0a∫0aφ(x,y)cosmπxacosnπyadxdy,
    其中
    Cmn=ηmηna2∫0a∫0aφ(x,y)cosmπxacosnπyadxdy,
    where
    m,n≥0、
    m,n≥0,
    η0=1,ηj=2（
    η0=1,ηj=2 for
    j>0）。
    j>0.
  3. 第 3 步Step 3

    解为

    Then

    u=∑m,n≥0Cmne−κπ2(m2+n2)t/a2cosmπxacosnπya.
    零模态
    u=∑m,n≥0Cmne−κπ2(m2+n2)t/a2cosmπxacosnπya.
    The zero mode
    C00=a−2∬φ 不衰减，其余模态衰减。
    C00=a−2∬φ does not decay; every other mode does.
  4. 第 4 步Step 4

    因此 t→∞ 时温度均匀并等于初始平均值；这与四边绝热时总热量守恒一致。

    Thus as t→∞, the temperature becomes uniform at the initial mean, consistent with heat conservation for four insulated edges.

最后答案Final answer

双重余弦级数如解，Cmn=ηmηna−2∬φcos(mπx/a)cos(nπy/a)，长期温度 C00。

The double-cosine series is given above, with Cmn=ηmηna−2∬φcos(mπx/a)cos(nπy/a). The long-time temperature is C00.

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

全绝热 → Neumann双重余弦含零频 → 按零/非零频率范数投影 → 平均温度守恒。

All edges insulated → Neumann double-cosine basis including zero frequencies → project with the correct zero/nonzero norms → mean temperature is conserved.

易错点

Common mistakes

从 m,n=1 开始会漏掉平均温度和单方向模态，结果一般不能恢复初温。

Starting at m,n=1 loses the mean temperature and modes varying in only one direction. The initial temperature then generally cannot be recovered.

习题 3.3 · 1Exercise 3.3 · 1教材 p.160 / PDF p.169Textbook p.160 / PDF p.169

矩形顶边给定温度A rectangle with prescribed top-edge temperature

求矩形内 uxx+uyy=0（0<x<a,0<y<b），u(0,y)=u(a,y)=0，u(x,0)=0，u(x,b)=f(x)。

Solve uxx+uyy=0 in 0<x<a,0<y<b, with u(0,y)=u(a,y)=0, u(x,0)=0, and u(x,b)=f(x).

这道题到底要什么What must you find?

从矩形顶边温度求整个矩形内的稳态温度。

Recover the steady temperature inside a rectangle from its top-edge data.

凭什么选这个方法Why this method?

这是无时间的 Laplace 方程。先满足三条零边，再用顶边来定每项系数。

Laplace’s equation has no time variable. Satisfy the three zero edges first, then use the top edge to set coefficients.

基础运算卡住时，先补这一项：If the basic calculation is unfamiliar, practice: 边界与本征值Boundaries and eigenvalues · 正交投影Orthogonal projection

零基础逐步讲解：一次只做一步Beginner walkthrough: one step at a time＋

先不要抄最终答案。看完当前一步，在纸上写完，再点“下一步”。Do not copy the final answer. Complete the current step on paper before choosing Next step.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    左右两边温度为零，先沿 x 选 Xn=sin(knx)，kn=nπ/a；这一选择自动处理两条齐次边界。

    Since both vertical sides have zero temperature, choose Xn=sin(knx) with kn=nπ/a, automatically satisfying those homogeneous boundaries.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    把 u=XnYn 代入 uxx+uyy=0，得到 Yn′′−kn2Yn=0，所以 Yn=Csinh(kny)+Dcosh(kny)。

    Substituting u=XnYn into uxx+uyy=0 gives Yn′′−kn2Yn=0, hence Yn=Csinh(kny)+Dcosh(kny).

  3. 第 3 步Step 3
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    底边 u(x,0)=0 令 D=0。

    The bottom condition u(x,0)=0 sets D=0.

    把竖向函数归一化为 Rn(y)=sinh(kny)/sinh(knb)，使它在底边为零、顶边为 1。

    Normalize the vertical factor as Rn(y)=sinh(kny)/sinh(knb), which is zero at the bottom and one at the top.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    将顶边数据展开为 f(x)=∑fnsin(knx)，其中 fn=2a∫0af(s)sin(kns)ds。

    Expand the top data as f(x)=∑fnsin(knx), where fn=2a∫0af(s)sin(kns)ds.

    积分中的 s 是哑变量，避免与待求位置混淆。

    The dummy variable s is distinct from the observation coordinate.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    写 u=∑n≥1fnRn(y)sin(knx)；令 y=b 时 Rn=1，恰好还原 f，另三边逐项为零。

    Write u=∑n≥1fnRn(y)sin(knx).

    At y=b, Rn=1 and the series recovers f, while the other three boundaries vanish term by term.

  6. 第 6 步Step 6
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    若要求闭矩形上的连续解，还要检查 f(0)=f(a)=0，否则角点同时被要求取两个不同值。

    A continuous solution on the closed rectangle requires f(0)=f(a)=0; otherwise a corner is assigned two different values.

    角点不相容时应只在边界内部按极限理解数据。

    With incompatible corners, interpret boundary values as limits along the interiors of edges.

做完先别看答案，自己检查Check your work before opening the answer

为什么用 sinh 而不是 cosh？

Why use sinh rather than cosh?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

因为底边 y=0 要为 0，而 sinh0=0、cosh0=1。

The value at y=0 must be zero: sinh0=0, while cosh0=1.

只看起手提示Show only a starting hint＋

将 f 在 (0,a) 展开正弦级数。

Expand f in a sine series on (0,a).

参考完整解答：先看分步讲解再打开Full reference solution: use after the guided steps＋
整道题的路线Plan for the whole problem

先利用左右两齐次边界选正弦；再用底边零值选双曲正弦。

The two zero side values select a sine basis. The zero bottom value then selects the hyperbolic sine.

把计算一行一行写出来Write the calculation line by line

设 kn=nπ/a。

分离的空间函数 Xn=sinknx，Yn′′−kn2Yn=0；由 Yn(0)=0 取 sinhkny。

把顶边归一为 1，得

u(x,y)=∑n=1∞fnsinhknysinhknbsinknx,fn=2a∫0af(s)sinknsds.
左右边和底边逐项满足，顶边还原 f 的正弦展开；每项满足 uxx+uyy=0。

若要闭矩形上的连续解，须有角点相容 f(0)=f(a)=0，否则在边界内部按迹/极限理解。

Set kn=nπ/a.

Separation gives Xn=sinknx and Yn′′−kn2Yn=0.

Since Yn(0)=0, choose sinhkny.

Normalize its value at the top to 1:

u(x,y)=∑n=1∞fnsinhknysinhknbsinknx,fn=2a∫0af(s)sinknsds.
The side and bottom values hold term by term; the top reproduces f’s sine expansion.

Every term satisfies Laplace’s equation uxx+uyy=0.

For continuity on the closed rectangle, corner compatibility requires f(0)=f(a)=0.

Otherwise interpret the boundary data as traces or limits away from the corners.

最后答案Final answer

u=∑n≥1fnsinh(nπy/a)sin(nπx/a)/sinh(nπb/a)。

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

三边零一边给定 → 齐次方向的本征函数 → 双曲传播比值 → 边界正交投影。

Three zero edges and one prescribed edge → eigenfunctions in the homogeneous direction → a hyperbolic ratio across the rectangle → project the boundary values.

易错点

Common mistakes

双曲正弦分母是顶边处的值；不能漏归一化导致顶边系数错误。

The denominator is the hyperbolic sine evaluated at the top. Omitting this normalization gives the wrong top-edge coefficients.

习题 3.3 · 2Exercise 3.3 · 2教材 p.160 / PDF p.169Textbook p.160 / PDF p.169

矩形混合边界通量A rectangle with mixed boundaries and prescribed flux

求 uxx+uyy=0（0<x<a,0<y<b），u(0,y)=0、ux(a,y)=f(y)，u(x,0)=0、uy(x,b)=0。

Solve uxx+uyy=0 in 0<x<a,0<y<b, with u(0,y)=0, ux(a,y)=f(y), u(x,0)=0, and uy(x,b)=0.

这道题到底要什么What must you find?

求右边给导数、上下混合边界的矩形稳态场。

Solve a steady rectangle with prescribed right derivative and mixed top/bottom conditions.

凭什么选这个方法Why this method?

先找上下两条齐次边界对应的模式；右边给的是导数，归一化也必须对导数做。

Choose modes from the two homogeneous horizontal boundaries first. Because the right boundary specifies a derivative, normalize a derivative.

基础运算卡住时，先补这一项：If the basic calculation is unfamiliar, practice: 边界与本征值Boundaries and eigenvalues · 正交投影Orthogonal projection

零基础逐步讲解：一次只做一步Beginner walkthrough: one step at a time＋

先不要抄最终答案。看完当前一步，在纸上写完，再点“下一步”。Do not copy the final answer. Complete the current step on paper before choosing Next step.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    先处理 y 方向的齐次条件 Y(0)=0、Y′(b)=0：取 Y=sinμy，再由 cosμb=0 得 μn=(n+1/2)π/b，n≥0。

    First handle the homogeneous conditions Y(0)=0 and Y′(b)=0: choose Y=sinμy, then cosμb=0 gives μn=(n+1/2)π/b for n≥0.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    代入拉普拉斯方程得 Xn′′−μn2Xn=0。

    The Laplace equation gives Xn′′−μn2Xn=0.

    左边 Xn(0)=0 排除余弦双曲项，只剩 sinh(μnx)。

    The left condition Xn(0)=0 removes the hyperbolic cosine term, leaving sinh(μnx).

  3. 第 3 步Step 3
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    右边给的是 ux，所以先求导：[sinh(μnx)]′=μncosh(μnx)。

    The right boundary prescribes ux, so differentiate first: [sinh(μnx)]′=μncosh(μnx).

    令 Rn(x)=sinh(μnx)/[μncosh(μna)]，使 Rn′(a)=1。

    Define Rn(x)=sinh(μnx)/[μncosh(μna)] so that Rn′(a)=1.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    把 f(y) 投影到半整数正弦基：fn=2b∫0bf(s)sin(μns)ds，其中范数是 b/2。

    Project f(y) onto the half-integer sine basis: fn=2b∫0bf(s)sin(μns)ds, using squared norm b/2.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    合成 u=∑n≥0fnRn(x)sin(μny)。

    Assemble u=∑n≥0fnRn(x)sin(μny).

    对 x 求导再令 x=a，检查分母完全消掉，得到 f 的展开。

    Differentiate in x and set x=a; the denominator cancels, leaving the expansion of f.

  6. 第 6 步Step 6
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    另外检查 x=0、y=0 的函数值为零，y=b 的导数为零。

    Also check zero values at x=0 and y=0, and zero derivative at y=b.

    若误用 sinh(μna) 作分母，得到的是右边位移归一化，不满足本题通量条件。

    A denominator sinh(μna) would normalize the right value rather than the required flux.

做完先别看答案，自己检查Check your work before opening the answer

右边若给 uₓ=f，归一化分母应是什么？

What denominator is required for uₓ=f at the right edge?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

是 μₙcosh(μₙa)，即 sinh(μₙx) 在右端的导数。

μₙcosh(μₙa), the right-end derivative of sinh(μₙx).

只看起手提示Show only a starting hint＋

μn=(n+1/2)π/b，右边导数引入 μncosh(μna)。

μn=(n+1/2)π/b. The right-edge derivative introduces μncosh(μna).

参考完整解答：先看分步讲解再打开Full reference solution: use after the guided steps＋
整道题的路线Plan for the whole problem

上下混合边界决定半整数正弦；右边给导数，归一化要对双曲函数求导。

The mixed bottom/top boundaries select half-integer sine modes. The right boundary prescribes a derivative, so normalize the derivative of the hyperbolic factor.

把计算一行一行写出来Write the calculation line by line

由 Y(0)=0,Y′(b)=0，得 Yn=sinμny，μn=(n+1/2)π/b，n≥0。

在 x 方向，Xn′′−μn2Xn=0，Xn(0)=0，故取 sinhμnx。

令

fn=2b∫0bf(s)sinμnsds.
使右边导数恰等于展开后的 f，得到
u(x,y)=∑n=0∞fnsinhμnxμncoshμnasinμny.
求 x 导数并令 x=a 时归一因子完全抵消；其余三边齐次条件成立。

From Y(0)=0,Y′(b)=0, obtain Yn=sinμny, with μn=(n+1/2)π/b for n≥0.

In x, Xn′′−μn2Xn=0 and Xn(0)=0, so choose sinhμnx.

Let

fn=2b∫0bf(s)sinμnsds.
To make the right derivative equal the expansion of f, take
u(x,y)=∑n=0∞fnsinhμnxμncoshμnasinμny.
Differentiating in x and setting x=a cancels the normalization factor exactly.

The other three homogeneous boundary conditions also hold.

最后答案Final answer

u=∑n≥0fnsinh(μnx)sin(μny)/[μncosh(μna)]，fn=2b−1∫0bfsinμnsds。

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

混合齐次边界 → 半整数谱 → 非零通量边归一其导数 → 投影边界数据。

Homogeneous mixed boundaries → half-integer spectrum → normalize the derivative at the nonzero-flux edge → project the boundary data.

易错点

Common mistakes

右边给 ux，分母必须是 μncoshμna，不能用 sinhμna。

The right side specifies ux. Its denominator must be μncoshμna, not sinhμna.

习题 3.3 · 3Exercise 3.3 · 3教材 p.160 / PDF p.169Textbook p.160 / PDF p.169

两条非零边界的稳态叠加Superposition for two nonzero steady boundaries

矩形内 uxx+uyy=0；u(0,y)=Ay(b−y)、u(a,y)=0，u(x,0)=Bsin(πx/a)、u(x,b)=0。求 u。

Inside a rectangle, uxx+uyy=0. The boundaries are u(0,y)=Ay(b−y), u(a,y)=0, u(x,0)=Bsin(πx/a), and u(x,b)=0. Find u.

这道题到底要什么What must you find?

处理两个非零边界：分成两道单边题再相加。

Handle two nonzero boundaries by splitting into two single-edge problems.

凭什么选这个方法Why this method?

Laplace 方程是线性的，因此一部分只承担左边温度，另一部分只承担底边温度。

Laplace’s equation is linear. One part carries only the left-edge data; the other carries only the bottom data.

基础运算卡住时，先补这一项：If the basic calculation is unfamiliar, practice: 边界齐次化Homogeneous boundaries · 正交投影Orthogonal projection

零基础逐步讲解：一次只做一步Beginner walkthrough: one step at a time＋

先不要抄最终答案。看完当前一步，在纸上写完，再点“下一步”。Do not copy the final answer. Complete the current step on paper before choosing Next step.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    用线性叠加 u=v+w：让 v 只承担左边 Ay(b−y)，其余边为零；让 w 只承担底边 Bsin(πx/a)，其余边为零。

    Split u=v+w by linearity: let v carry only the left data Ay(b−y) with the other edges zero, and let w carry only the bottom data Bsin(πx/a).

  2. 第 2 步Step 2
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    左边驱动的部分沿 y 用 sin(nπy/b)；沿 x 用 sinh[nπ(a−x)/b]，这样右边 x=a 自动为零。

    For the left-driven part, use sin(nπy/b) in y and sinh[nπ(a−x)/b] in x, which vanishes at x=a.

    再除以其左边值 sinh(nπa/b)。

    Divide by its left value sinh(nπa/b).

  3. 第 3 步Step 3
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    投影左边数据：cn=2b∫0bAy(b−y)sin(nπy/b)dy=4Ab2[1−(−1)n]/(n3π3)。

    Project the left data: cn=2b∫0bAy(b−y)sin(nπy/b)dy=4Ab2[1−(−1)n]/(n3π3).

    偶数项为零，奇数项为 8Ab2/(n3π3)。

    Even terms vanish and odd terms equal 8Ab2/(n3π3).

  4. 第 4 步Step 4
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    因此 v=∑n≥1cnsinh[nπ(a−x)/b]sinh(nπa/b)sin(nπy/b)；若只写奇数和，令 n=2m+1。

    Thus v=∑n≥1cnsinh[nπ(a−x)/b]sinh(nπa/b)sin(nπy/b).

    For an odd-only sum, set n=2m+1.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    底边数据已经是一个模态，无需积分。

    The bottom data already form one mode, so no integral is needed.

    上边为零要求用 b−y，得到 w=Bsinh[π(b−y)/a]sinh(πb/a)sin(πx/a)。

    Zero top data require b−y, giving w=Bsinh[π(b−y)/a]sinh(πb/a)sin(πx/a).

  6. 第 6 步Step 6
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    最后相加并逐边核对：在左边 w=0，在底边 v=0，所以两部分不会干扰各自承担的数据；右边和顶边两部分都为零。

    Add the parts and check each edge: w=0 on the left and v=0 on the bottom, so neither interferes with the other's prescribed data.

    Both vanish on the right and top.

做完先别看答案，自己检查Check your work before opening the answer

左边驱动的双曲函数为何用 a−x？

Why use a−x for the left-driven hyperbolic factor?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

因为 x=a 时 a−x=0，这样右边自动为 0。

At x=a, a−x=0, so the right boundary vanishes automatically.

只看起手提示Show only a starting hint＋

Ay(b−y) 的正弦系数只含奇数，值为 8Ab2/(n3π3)。

The sine expansion of Ay(b−y) contains only odd n, with coefficients 8Ab2/(n3π3).

参考完整解答：先看分步讲解再打开Full reference solution: use after the guided steps＋
整道题的路线Plan for the whole problem

线性叠加为左边单独非零与底边单独非零两个问题。

Split by linear superposition into one problem with only the left edge nonzero and another with only the bottom edge nonzero.

把计算一行一行写出来Write the calculation line by line

令 u=v+w。

v 只承担左边 Ay(b−y)，其余三边零；w 只承担底边 Bsin(πx/a)，其余三边零。

左边投影系数

cn=2b∫0bAy(b−y)sinnπybdy=4Ab2[1−(−1)n]n3π3.
于是
v=8Ab2π3∑m=0∞sinh[(2m+1)π(a−x)/b](2m+1)3sinh[(2m+1)πa/b]sin(2m+1)πyb.
底边是单一模态，故
w=Bsinh[π(b−y)/a]sinh(πb/a)sinπxa.
所求为二者相加。

四角数据都为零，相互相容；检查 x=0 与 y=0 的非齐次边时另一部分恰为零。

Let u=v+w.

Function v carries only the left data Ay(b−y), with zero values on the other three edges.

Function w carries only the bottom data Bsin(πx/a), with zero values on the other edges.

The left-edge projection coefficients are

cn=2b∫0bAy(b−y)sinnπybdy=4Ab2[1−(−1)n]n3π3.
Thus
v=8Ab2π3∑m=0∞sinh[(2m+1)π(a−x)/b](2m+1)3sinh[(2m+1)πa/b]sin(2m+1)πyb.
The bottom data are a single mode, giving
w=Bsinh[π(b−y)/a]sinh(πb/a)sinπxa.
Add the two parts.

All four corner values are zero and compatible.

On x=0 and y=0, respectively, the other part is zero, so the prescribed data are recovered.

最后答案Final answer

u=v+w，其中 v 为上述左边奇数正弦级数，w=Bsinh[π(b−y)/a]sin(πx/a)/sinh(πb/a)。

u=v+w, where v is the left-edge odd-sine series above and w=Bsinh[π(b−y)/a]sin(πx/a)/sinh(πb/a).

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

多非零边 → 叠加拆成单边驱动 → 分别选择正交方向 → 最后逐边核对。

Several nonzero edges → split into single-edge problems → choose the appropriate orthogonal direction for each → check every edge after adding.

易错点

Common mistakes

在左边驱动的项里使用 a−x 才能令右边为零；底边驱动要用 b−y。

Use a−x for the left-driven term so it vanishes on the right. Use b−y for the bottom-driven term so it vanishes on the top.

施图姆–刘维尔本征值问题Sturm–Liouville eigenvalue problems

4 道主编号题4 numbered exercises
习题 3.4 · 1Exercise 3.4 · 1教材 p.163 / PDF p.172Textbook p.163 / PDF p.172

拉盖尔方程自伴化Self-adjoint form of Laguerre’s equation

将拉盖尔方程 xy″+(1−x)y′+ay=0 化为标准施图姆–刘维尔形式，并确定权函数。

Put Laguerre’s equation xy″+(1−x)y′+ay=0 in standard Sturm–Liouville form and determine its weight.

这道题到底要什么What must you find?

把 Laguerre 方程改成总导数形式，并找到投影需要的权。

Convert Laguerre’s equation to a total-derivative form and identify the projection weight.

凭什么选这个方法Why this method?

自伴形式把 y″、y′ 合在 (py′)′ 里；权函数是本征参数前的系数，不是 p。

Self-adjoint form combines y″ and y′ into (py′)′. The weight is the coefficient of the eigenvalue parameter, not p.

零基础逐步讲解：一次只做一步Beginner walkthrough: one step at a time＋

先不要抄最终答案。看完当前一步，在纸上写完，再点“下一步”。Do not copy the final answer. Complete the current step on paper before choosing Next step.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    目标是把 xy″+(1−x)y′ 合并成 (py′)′。

    The goal is to combine xy″+(1−x)y′ into (py′)′.

    乘一个待求因子 μ(x) 后，需要 (μx)′=μ(1−x)。

    After multiplying by an unknown factor μ(x), require (μx)′=μ(1−x).

  2. 第 2 步Step 2
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    展开等式：xμ′+μ=μ−xμ，所以 μ′=−μ；可取 μ=e−x，正常数倍不会改变权的作用。

    Expand to xμ′+μ=μ−xμ, hence μ′=−μ.

    Choose μ=e−x; a positive constant multiple does not change the role of the weight.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    原方程乘 e−x 后，前两项正好是 (xe−xy′)′，因此自伴形式为 (xe−xy′)′+ae−xy=0。

    Multiplying by e−x makes the first two terms exactly (xe−xy′)′, giving self-adjoint form (xe−xy′)′+ae−xy=0.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    与 (py′)′−qy+λwy=0 对照：p=xe−x、q=0、λ=a、w=e−x。

    Compare with (py′)′−qy+λwy=0: p=xe−x, q=0, λ=a, and w=e−x.

    权函数来自本征参数项，不能把 p 当成权。

    Read the weight from the eigenvalue term, not from the derivative coefficient p.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    在通常区间 (0,∞)，p,w 均为正；展开总导数可恢复原方程。

    要进一步讨论正交性或谱，还需选择端点正则/可积条件，单靠自伴化并未完成边界问题。

    On the usual interval (0,∞), both p and w are positive.

    Expanding the total derivative recovers the equation.

    Orthogonality and spectra additionally require suitable endpoint conditions; self-adjoint rewriting alone is not a full boundary problem.

做完先别看答案，自己检查Check your work before opening the answer

本题的权是 xe^(−x) 还是 e^(−x)？

Is the weight xe^(−x) or e^(−x)?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

是 e^(−x)；xe^(−x) 是导数项系数 p。

It is e^(−x). The factor xe^(−x) is the derivative coefficient p.

只看起手提示Show only a starting hint＋

乘 e−x，因为 (xe−x)′=(1−x)e−x。

Multiply by e−x, since (xe−x)′=(1−x)e−x.

参考完整解答：先看分步讲解再打开Full reference solution: use after the guided steps＋
整道题的路线Plan for the whole problem

找乘子使一、二阶导数合并为一个总导数。

Find a multiplier that combines the first and second derivatives into one total derivative.

把计算一行一行写出来Write the calculation line by line

原方程乘 e−x 得 xe−xy″+(1−x)e−xy′+ae−xy=0。

前两项恰为

(xe−xy′)′+ae−xy=0.
与 (py′)′−qy+λwy=0 比较，p=xe−x,q=0,λ=a,w=e−x。

通常区间为 (0,∞)，在该区间权函数为正。

若研究拉盖尔多项式的正交性，还需在零点和无穷远选合适的正则/可积解，不能只靠方程确定全部边界谱。

Multiplication by e−x gives xe−xy″+(1−x)e−xy′+ae−xy=0.

The first two terms combine to give

(xe−xy′)′+ae−xy=0.
Comparing with (py′)′−qy+λwy=0, obtain p=xe−x,q=0,λ=a,w=e−x.

The usual interval is (0,∞), where the weight is positive.

To study Laguerre-polynomial orthogonality, suitable regular or integrable solutions must also be chosen at zero and infinity.

The differential equation alone does not determine the full boundary spectrum.

最后答案Final answer

(xe−xy′)′+ae−xy=0；权函数 w=e−x（常数倍等价）。

(xe−xy′)′+ae−xy=0, with weight w=e−x, up to a positive constant factor.

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

一般二阶方程自伴化 → 乘子使 (μa2)′=μa1 → 读出参数系数为权。

Self-adjoint conversion → choose a multiplier satisfying (μa2)′=μa1 → identify the coefficient of the eigenvalue as the weight.

易错点

Common mistakes

权函数是参数项的系数，不是导数项 xe−x。

The weight is the coefficient multiplying the eigenvalue parameter, not the derivative coefficient xe−x.

习题 3.4 · 2Exercise 3.4 · 2教材 p.163 / PDF p.172Textbook p.163 / PDF p.172

埃尔米特方程自伴化Self-adjoint form of Hermite’s equation

将埃尔米特方程 y″−2xy′+2ay=0 化为标准施图姆–刘维尔形式，并确定权函数。

Put Hermite’s equation y″−2xy′+2ay=0 in standard Sturm–Liouville form and determine its weight.

这道题到底要什么What must you find?

把 Hermite 方程写成自伴形式，避免权函数差一个 2。

Put Hermite’s equation in self-adjoint form without losing a factor of two.

凭什么选这个方法Why this method?

y′ 的系数 −2x 是 e^(−x²) 的对数导数，所以用高斯因子把导数项合并。

The coefficient −2x is the logarithmic derivative of e^(−x²), so a Gaussian multiplier combines the derivatives.

零基础逐步讲解：一次只做一步Beginner walkthrough: one step at a time＋

先不要抄最终答案。看完当前一步，在纸上写完，再点“下一步”。Do not copy the final answer. Complete the current step on paper before choosing Next step.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    为合并 y″−2xy′，寻找 μ 使 μy″+μ′y′=μ(y″−2xy′)，故要求 μ′/μ=−2x。

    To combine y″−2xy′, seek μ such that μy″+μ′y′=μ(y″−2xy′).

    Thus μ′/μ=−2x.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    积分 lnμ=−x2+C，取 μ=e−x2。

    Integrate to lnμ=−x2+C and choose μ=e−x2.

    用 μ′=−2xμ 检查符号。

    Check the sign with μ′=−2xμ.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    将原方程乘该因子，得 (e−x2y′)′+2ae−x2y=0，这就是所求自伴形式。

    Multiply the equation by this factor to obtain the self-adjoint form (e−x2y′)′+2ae−x2y=0.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    若定义 λ=2a，则 p=w=e−x2、q=0；若坚持 λ=a，权改为 2e−x2。

    参数和权必须一起选择，不能混用两套写法。

    If λ=2a, then p=w=e−x2 and q=0.

    If λ=a, use weight 2e−x2 instead.

    Choose the parameter and weight consistently.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    通常在全实轴使用内积 ∫e−x2fgdx。

    On the real line, use inner product ∫e−x2fgdx.

    高斯权让多项式乘积可积，但谱或正交性仍需说明无穷远边界项如何消失。

    The Gaussian weight makes polynomial products integrable, but spectral or orthogonality arguments must still justify the vanishing boundary term at infinity.

做完先别看答案，自己检查Check your work before opening the answer

若 λ 定义为 a，w 能仍写 e^(−x²) 吗？

If λ is defined as a, can w still be e^(−x²)?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

不能；此时 w=2e^(−x²)。若 w=e^(−x²)，则 λ=2a。

No. Then w=2e^(−x²). With w=e^(−x²), use λ=2a.

只看起手提示Show only a starting hint＋

乘 e−x2，其导数为 −2xe−x2。

Multiply by e−x2, whose derivative is −2xe−x2.

参考完整解答：先看分步讲解再打开Full reference solution: use after the guided steps＋
整道题的路线Plan for the whole problem

导数项提示高斯积分因子。

The first-derivative term suggests a Gaussian integrating factor.

把计算一行一行写出来Write the calculation line by line

乘 e−x2 后，

Multiplying by e−x2 gives

e−x2y″−2xe−x2y′+2ae−x2y=0,
即
e−x2y″−2xe−x2y′+2ae−x2y=0,
or
(e−x2y′)′+2ae−x2y=0.
取
(e−x2y′)′+2ae−x2y=0.
Take
p=e−x2,q=0,λ=2a,w=e−x2；若坚持用
p=e−x2,q=0,λ=2a,w=e−x2.
λ=a，则权写

If one instead insists on λ=a, use weight 2e−x2, differing only by a positive constant.

2e−x2，与前者只差正常数。

The usual interval is the full line, with inner product ∫−∞∞e−x2fgdx.

通常区间为全轴，带权内积 ∫−∞∞e−x2fgdx，边界须选择使积分与边界项合适的解。

Boundary behavior must make the integrals and boundary terms appropriate.

最后答案Final answer

(e−x2y′)′+2ae−x2y=0；w=e−x2、λ=2a。

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

一阶导系数积分 → 高斯乘子 → 总导数 → 明确本征参数如何定义。

Integrate the first-derivative coefficient → obtain a Gaussian multiplier → form a total derivative → state the eigenvalue-parameter convention.

易错点

Common mistakes

不要把 2a 与 a 的参数选择混用；权允许乘正常数，但须与本征参数一致。

Do not mix the choices λ=2a and λ=a. A positive constant may be absorbed into the weight, but it must match the chosen parameter.

习题 3.4 · 3Exercise 3.4 · 3教材 p.164 / PDF p.173Textbook p.164 / PDF p.173

切比雪夫方程自伴化Self-adjoint form of Chebyshev’s equation

将切比雪夫方程 (1−x2)y″−xy′+n2y=0 化为标准施图姆–刘维尔形式，并确定权函数。

Put Chebyshev’s equation (1−x2)y″−xy′+n2y=0 in standard Sturm–Liouville form and determine its weight.

这道题到底要什么What must you find?

推导 Chebyshev 正交时为什么要带倒平方根的权。

Derive the inverse-square-root weight in Chebyshev orthogonality.

凭什么选这个方法Why this method?

(1−x²) 的系数不会直接给权；先找乘子使导数项成为一个总导数。

The leading factor 1−x² does not directly identify the weight. First choose a multiplier that creates a total derivative.

零基础逐步讲解：一次只做一步Beginner walkthrough: one step at a time＋

先不要抄最终答案。看完当前一步，在纸上写完，再点“下一步”。Do not copy the final answer. Complete the current step on paper before choosing Next step.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    在 −1<x<1 内找乘子 μ，使 [μ(1−x2)]′=−xμ。

    On −1<x<1, seek a multiplier satisfying [μ(1−x2)]′=−xμ.

    展开得 (1−x2)μ′=xμ。

    Expanding gives (1−x2)μ′=xμ.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    积分 μ′/μ=x/(1−x2)，得 lnμ=−12ln(1−x2)+C，可取 μ=(1−x2)−1/2。

    Integrating μ′/μ=x/(1−x2) gives lnμ=−12ln(1−x2)+C, so choose μ=(1−x2)−1/2.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    乘入方程并核对乘积导数：(1−x2y′)′+n2y/1−x2=0。

    Multiply the equation and check the product derivative to obtain (1−x2y′)′+n2y/1−x2=0.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    读出 p=1−x2、q=0、λ=n2、w=1/1−x2。

    Read off p=1−x2, q=0, λ=n2, and w=1/1−x2.

    p 与 w 互为倒数，在答题时应分开标注。

    Label p and w separately because they are reciprocals.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    用 x=cosθ 自检：wdx=−dθ，所以带权积分转成普通三角积分。

    Check with x=cosθ: wdx=−dθ, converting weighted integrals to ordinary trigonometric integrals.

    端点权虽发散但可积；端点属于奇异端点，不能直接套正则端点结论。

    The weight diverges but is integrable at the singular endpoints, where regular-endpoint conclusions need care.

做完先别看答案，自己检查Check your work before opening the answer

权与 p 是否相同？

Are the weight and p identical?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

不同；p 是平方根，w 是它的倒数。

No. p is the square root, while w is its reciprocal.

只看起手提示Show only a starting hint＋

在 −1<x<1 上乘 (1−x2)−1/2。

For −1<x<1, multiply by (1−x2)−1/2.

参考完整解答：先看分步讲解再打开Full reference solution: use after the guided steps＋
整道题的路线Plan for the whole problem

乘子需使 1−x2 的导数匹配一阶项。

Choose a multiplier so that the derivative of 1−x2 matches the first-derivative term.

把计算一行一行写出来Write the calculation line by line

乘以 1/1−x2 后，导数两项为

1−x2y″−x1−x2y′=(1−x2y′)′.
因此
(1−x2y′)′+n2y1−x2=0.
读得 p=1−x2,q=0,λ=n2,w=(1−x2)−1/2。

标准区间 (−1,1)，端点为奇异端点，权虽然发散但可积。

令 x=cosθ，wdx 转为 −dθ，也解释了 Tn(x)=cos(nθ) 的带权正交。

After multiplying by 1/1−x2, the derivative terms are

1−x2y″−x1−x2y′=(1−x2y′)′.
Hence
(1−x2y′)′+n2y1−x2=0.
Read off p=1−x2,q=0,λ=n2,w=(1−x2)−1/2.

The standard interval is (−1,1), with singular endpoints.

Although the weight diverges there, it is integrable.

Under x=cosθ, wdx becomes −dθ, explaining the weighted orthogonality of Tn(x)=cos(nθ).

最后答案Final answer

(1−x2y′)′+n2(1−x2)−1/2y=0；w=(1−x2)−1/2。

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

配积分因子 → 读权函数 → 用三角换元检查正交权。

Find an integrating factor → identify the weight → check the orthogonality weight by a trigonometric substitution.

易错点

Common mistakes

权是倒平方根，不能与 p=1−x2 互换。

The weight is the inverse square root; do not interchange it with p=1−x2.

实谱证明与非负谱命题的反例Real eigenvalues and a counterexample to nonnegativity

本征问题 (ky′)′−qy+λρy=0（a<x<b），边界 α1y(a)+α2y′(a)=0、β1y(b)+β2y′(b)=0。题给 k,q,ρ 为非负实函数、边界系数为实常数，要求证明：(1)本征值均为实数；(2)本征值均非负。

Consider (ky′)′−qy+λρy=0 for a<x<b, with α1y(a)+α2y′(a)=0 and β1y(b)+β2y′(b)=0. The question gives nonnegative real functions k,q,ρ and real boundary constants, and asks to prove: (1) all eigenvalues are real; (2) all eigenvalues are nonnegative.

读题注意Read this first

第二问对任意实 Robin 边界系数声称本征值非负不成立。解析给出 λ=−1 的反例，并列出可保证非负的能量条件。

Part (2) incorrectly claims nonnegative eigenvalues for arbitrary real Robin coefficients. The solution gives a λ=−1 counterexample and sufficient energy conditions for nonnegativity.

这道题到底要什么What must you find?

分清“本征值为实数”和“本征值非负”需要不同条件。

Separate the assumptions for real eigenvalues from those for nonnegative eigenvalues.

凭什么选这个方法Why this method?

实 Robin 边界使边界的反对称项消失，但能量里的边界项不一定非负。题目第二问缺条件。

Real Robin boundaries cancel the antisymmetric boundary term, but their energy contribution need not be nonnegative. Part (2) is missing a condition.

零基础逐步讲解：一次只做一步Beginner walkthrough: one step at a time＋

先不要抄最终答案。看完当前一步，在纸上写完，再点“下一步”。Do not copy the final answer. Complete the current step on paper before choosing Next step.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    先列适用条件：正则实谱证明需 k>0、ρ>0，系数足够连续，且每端的两个边界系数不同时为零。

    First state the assumptions: a regular real-spectrum proof needs k>0, ρ>0, sufficiently continuous coefficients, and a nonzero boundary coefficient pair at each end.

    原题只写非负可能退化，不能跳过这个检查。

    Mere nonnegativity can allow degeneracy.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    第(1)问用原方程乘 y¯，共轭方程乘 y，再相减积分，得到 (λ−λ¯)∫abρ|y|2dx=−[k(y′y¯−yy¯′)]ab。

    For part (1), multiply the equation by y¯ and its conjugate by y, subtract, and integrate: (λ−λ¯)∫abρ|y|2dx=−[k(y′y¯−yy¯′)]ab.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    实边界条件使每个端点的括号为零：若是 Dirichlet 则 y=0；否则 y′=cy 且 c 为实数。

    Real separated conditions make each endpoint bracket zero: either y=0 or y′=cy for a real constant c.

    因为非零本征函数的加权范数严格正，得 λ=λ¯。

    The weighted norm of a nonzero eigenfunction is positive, so λ=λ¯.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    第(2)问先不要删边界项。

    For part (2), keep the boundary term.

    原方程乘 y¯ 积分分部，得 λ∫ρ|y|2dx=∫(k|y′|2+q|y|2)dx−[ky′y¯]ab。

    Multiplying by y¯ and integrating by parts gives λ∫ρ|y|2dx=∫(k|y′|2+q|y|2)dx−[ky′y¯]ab.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    检验原命题的反例：取 (0,1)、k=ρ=1,q=0，两端均为 y′−y=0。

    y=ex 满足边界，且 y″+λy=0 给 λ=−1，所以任意实 Robin 条件并不保证非负谱。

    Test the claim with (0,1), k=ρ=1, q=0, and y′−y=0 at both ends.

    The function y=ex satisfies the boundaries, and y″+λy=0 gives λ=−1.

    Arbitrary real Robin conditions do not guarantee a nonnegative spectrum.

  6. 第 6 步Step 6
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    若两端为 Dirichlet 或 Neumann，边界项为零，才可由非负积分推出 λ≥0。

    With Dirichlet or Neumann conditions, the boundary term vanishes and the nonnegative integral gives λ≥0.

    Robin 时边界贡献是 k(b)(β1/β2)|y(b)|2−k(a)(α1/α2)|y(a)|2，需另查符号。

    For Robin conditions, the contribution is k(b)(β1/β2)|y(b)|2−k(a)(α1/α2)|y(a)|2, whose sign must be checked.

  7. 第 7 步Step 7
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    答题结论分开写：标准非退化自伴条件下实谱成立；原题的非负谱命题缺条件，并给上述反例。

    State the conclusions separately: real eigenvalues follow under regular nondegenerate self-adjoint assumptions, while the nonnegative-spectrum claim lacks conditions and has the counterexample above.

    补 α1/α2≤0、β1/β2≥0 等足够条件后可得到非负谱。

    Sufficient extra signs include α1/α2≤0 and β1/β2≥0.

做完先别看答案，自己检查Check your work before opening the answer

边界 y′−y=0 下，y=eˣ 对应 λ 是几？

With y′−y=0, what eigenvalue belongs to y=eˣ?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

代入 y″+λy=0 得 1+λ=0，所以 λ=−1；实谱并不等于非负谱。

Substitution in y″+λy=0 gives 1+λ=0, so λ=−1. A real spectrum need not be nonnegative.

只看起手提示Show only a starting hint＋

反例：区间 (0,1)，k=ρ=1,q=0，两端均取 y′−y=0，y=ex 对应 λ=−1。

Counterexample: on (0,1), take k=ρ=1,q=0 and y′−y=0 at both endpoints. The function y=ex has λ=−1.

参考完整解答：先看分步讲解再打开Full reference solution: use after the guided steps＋
整道题的路线Plan for the whole problem

用拉格朗日恒等式证明实谱，用能量商检查非负性；第二个命题缺少边界符号条件，原样不成立。

Use the Lagrange identity to prove reality and the energy quotient to inspect nonnegativity. The second statement lacks boundary sign conditions and is false as written.

把计算一行一行写出来Write the calculation line by line

先补标准非退化假设：正则问题需 k>0,ρ>0，每个端点的两边界系数不同时为零；仅写“非负”允许退化，甚至 ρ≡0 会让参数失去谱意义。

(1)对本征函数 y 的方程乘 y¯，减去共轭方程乘 y，在 [a,b] 积分得

(λ−λ¯)∫abρ|y|2dx=−[k(y′y¯−yy¯′)]ab.
实分离边界保证每个端点括号为零：Dirichlet时 y=0；否则 y′ 是实常数乘 y。

积分严格正，故 λ=λ¯。

(2)原题“所有实常数边界都使本征值非负”是错误的。

取 a=0,b=1,k=ρ=1,q=0，边界 y′(0)−y(0)=y′(1)−y(1)=0。

y=ex 非零，满足两边界且 y″−y=0，故对应 λ=−1<0，完全符合原题系数条件。

正确判据来自能量商：

λ=∫ab[k|y′|2+q|y|2]dx−[ky′y¯]ab∫abρ|y|2dx.
Dirichlet或Neumann边界使边界项为零，所以 λ≥0。

若两端均为Robin且 α2β2≠0，边界贡献为

k(b)β1β2|y(b)|2−k(a)α1α2|y(a)|2.
例如补上 α1/α2≤0、β1/β2≥0 就可保证非负；更一般的充分必要表述是整个能量二次型非负。

不能为了完成证明而删掉原题允许的Robin边界。

First add the standard nondegeneracy assumptions: a regular problem needs k>0,ρ>0, and the two boundary coefficients at either endpoint cannot both be zero.

Mere nonnegativity permits degeneracy; for example, ρ≡0 removes the parameter’s spectral meaning. (1) Multiply the equation for eigenfunction y by y¯ and subtract its conjugate multiplied by y.

Integration over [a,b] gives

(λ−λ¯)∫abρ|y|2dx=−[k(y′y¯−yy¯′)]ab.
The real separated boundaries make the bracket zero at each endpoint: for Dirichlet data y=0; otherwise y′ is a real constant times y.

The integral is strictly positive, hence λ=λ¯. (2) The original claim that all real boundary constants give nonnegative eigenvalues is false.

Set a=0,b=1,k=ρ=1,q=0, with y′(0)−y(0)=y′(1)−y(1)=0.

The nonzero function y=ex satisfies both boundaries and y″−y=0, giving λ=−1<0.

All coefficient requirements in the question are met.

The correct test comes from the energy quotient:

λ=∫ab[k|y′|2+q|y|2]dx−[ky′y¯]ab∫abρ|y|2dx.
Dirichlet or Neumann boundaries eliminate the boundary term, so λ≥0.

For Robin conditions at both ends with α2β2≠0, the boundary contribution is

k(b)β1β2|y(b)|2−k(a)α1α2|y(a)|2.
For example, adding α1/α2≤0 and β1/β2≥0 ensures nonnegativity.

More generally, the necessary and sufficient formulation is nonnegativity of the whole energy quadratic form.

One must not discard the Robin boundaries allowed by the question just to complete a proof.

最后答案Final answer

(1)在标准非退化自伴假设下本征值为实数。(2)原题不成立：y=ex、两端 y′−y=0 给 λ=−1。补充使能量边界贡献非负的条件后，才有 λ≥0。

(1) Eigenvalues are real under the standard nondegenerate self-adjoint assumptions. (2) The original statement is false: y=ex with y′−y=0 at both ends gives λ=−1. Only after adding conditions making the energy boundary contribution nonnegative can one conclude λ≥0.

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

谱性质题 → 先查假设是否足够 → 共轭相减证明实性 → 能量商看符号 → 不足时提供具体反例与正确版本。

Spectral-property question → inspect the assumptions → subtract conjugates to prove reality → use the energy quotient for signs → when assumptions fail, give a concrete counterexample and a correct statement.

易错点

Common mistakes

实Robin边界保证自伴与实谱，不自动保证非负谱；积分分部后的边界项不能擅自丢掉。

Real Robin boundaries ensure self-adjointness and a real spectrum, but do not automatically ensure a nonnegative spectrum. Do not drop the boundary term after integration by parts.
